가열된 볼트를 연달아 발사합니다. 발사하는 동안 석궁에 열기가 축적되고,: Fire a stream of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire, and reaching maximum heat will prevent you from firing these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits.
가열된 볼트를 탑재한 대형 탄창을 석궁에 장전합니다. 발사하는 동안 석궁: Load your Crossbow with a large clip of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire them, and reaching maximum Heat will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
가호를 부여하고 이어지는 방패 공격이 피해를 줄 때 방어 파장을 발동시키: Perform a Warcry that grants Guard and Triggers Shield Wave when subsequent Shield Attacks deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
감전 확률을 증가시키는 버프를 획득합니다. 적을 감전시키면 버프를 소모하: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.
감전된 적으로부터 주변의 흠뻑 젖은 적을 향해 연쇄되는 번개 투사체를 내: Sends a Chaining Lightning Projectile from the Shocked enemy towards a nearby Drenched enemy, dealing Spell damage.
Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.
강력하게 창을 투척합니다. 격분 충전을 보유한 경우 소모하여 창이 비행: Hurl your Spear with force. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to cause the Spear to explode at the end of its flight.
강력한 근접 타격으로 적들을 공격하여 받는 명중 피해를 감소시켜 주는 방: Attacks enemies with a powerful melee strike which grants Fortification, reducing damage you take from hits. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.
강력한 힘으로 창을 투척하여 떨어지는 곳에 와류를 불러일으키고, 효과 범: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.
강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 강타 스킬로 인한 여진이 항상 요철: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.
강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 가시나무를 발동시켜 위해를 끼: Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.
강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 사용 시 인내 충전을 소모하여: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.
강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 일정 확률로 여진을 생성하고,: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills a chance to create an Aftershock as well as increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time
강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 일정 확률로 여진을 유발하는 보조 대상 스킬의: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.
Direct your ants to move to the target location.
거대 덩굴의 성장을 촉진합니다. 덩굴은 대상 범위 내에서 무작위로 자라나: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.
거리를 두고 사용 시, 사슬을 투척하여 명중시킨 적 방향으로 이동하는 동: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly.
격노가 이미 최대인 동안 격노를 획득하여 영광을 축적합니다. 영광이 최대: Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.
격노와 생명력을 부여해 줄 증오에 찬 에너지를 불러냅니다. 활성화된 동안: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful Remnant, and Hitting a Bleeding target spawns a Hateful Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful Remnant grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.
격분 충전을 모두 소모하고 창을 크게 내질러 적들을 밀어냅니다. 소모한: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.
고대의 부활하는 아즈메리 늑대를 소환합니다. 늑대는 명령을 받으면 울부짖: Summons an ancient Reviving Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on Command. It Maims when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict Bleeding, or howl to inspire nearby allies.
Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Direct your feline companion to mesmerize another player's pet.
고정된 대상을 처치할 때 대상의 최대 생명력에 따라 물리 범위 피해를 줍: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the maximum Life of the Pinned target slain.
곰 혼백 반려수를 불러냅니다. 곰 혼백은 적들에게 달려들어 힘줄을 절단하: Call upon a Bear Spirit Companion to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to Maim them, Leeches Life with its slam, and periodically roars to Intimidate enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your Companion limit.
곰으로 형태 변환하고 반복적으로 바닥을 내리쳐, 전방에 넓은 호를 그리며: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
곰으로 형태 변환하고 저항의 포효를 내질러, 이어지는 공격들을 강화하여: Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
곰으로 형태 변환하고 전방을 향해 돌진하며, 달리는 동안 지면을 강타합니: Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.
곰으로 형태 변환하여 막강한 위력으로 지면을 강타하여, 충격파를 2개 생: Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.
곰으로 형태 변환하여 적들을 발톱으로 할큅니다. 적을 명중시키면 격노를: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.
공격 사거리가 늘어나며, 처음 타격당한 적에게서 얼음 칼날이 뚫고 나와: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies.
공격 속도와 생명력 흡수를 증가시키는 반면, 지속 물리 피해를 받는 버프: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.
공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 명중 시 적에게 절개가 유발되어: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.
공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 유발한 출혈의 지속시간이 크게: Supports Attack Skills. Bleeding inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict Bleeding onto with Supported Skills will move and Attack faster.
공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 명중 시 힘줄 절단을 소모하여: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.
공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 혼미 상태의 적에게 항상 명중: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills always hit Dazed Enemies, but Consume Daze on Hit, and cannot themselves inflict Daze. Cannot Support Skills which Consume Daze.
공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 사용 중인 무기 세트에 따라 공격 속도가 빨라지: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 희귀 및 고유 적을 명중하면 마무리 타격: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.
Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.
공격과 함성에 적용됩니다. 공격이 적의 방어구를 완전히 파괴하면 화염 폭: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.
Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.
공격에 적용되어, 물리 피해가 생명력을 흡수하게 하고 이 방식으로 얻은: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.
공격에 적용되어, 보조 대상 공격이 강력 기절시키는 적 아래에서 룬 충격: Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.
공격에 적용되어, 적중하는 적에게 걸린 원소 상태 이상의 수에 따라 주는: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.
Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.
Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.
Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
공격에 적용됩니다. 공격의 정확도가 올라가고, 최대 생명력 상태인 적을: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.
Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.
공격에 적용됩니다. 공격이 방어구를 완전히 파괴하면 적을 혼미하게 합니다: Supports Attacks, causing them to Daze Enemies when they fully Break Armour.
공격에 적용됩니다. 공격이 점화된 적에게 추가 화염 피해를 주지만, 점화: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.
Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.
Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.
Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.
Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.
공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 명중 시 적을 꿰뚫지만, 직접 꿰뚫: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.
공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 생명력이 최대인 적 명중 시 출혈을: Supports Attacks. Supported Skills are far more likely to inflict Bleeding on Hitting full Life Enemies.
공격에 적용됩니다. 플레이어와 근접해 있는 정도에 따라 적에게 주는 피해: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.
Crystallises the air into icy shards that explode outwards when they hit the ground.
공물 스킬에 적용되어, 연속 가능한 주문이 보조 대상 공물의 위치로 연속: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.
공물 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 생명력의 일부가 희생되: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.
공물 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 생명력의 일부가 희생됩: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.
공물 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 버프 효과가 증가하고 주는 피: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.
공중으로 도약 후 착지하면서 무기로 적들에게 피해를 주고 밀어냅니다. 착:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way.
공중으로 도약하는 근접 스킬에 적용되어, 착지할 때 균열을 생성하게 합니: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
공중으로 도약하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 착지하는 지역에 있는 시신이 격렬하: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
공중으로 도약하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 착지할 때 신성화 지대를 생성합니다: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.
Jump into the air, damaging enemies where you land.
공중으로 도약하여 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 적에게 처음으로 치명타: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.
공중으로 도약한 후 창을 바닥의 목표 지점에 내리꽂아, 번개를 띤 충격파: Leap into the air and plunge your Spear into the ground at the target location, emitting a Lightning-charged shockwave.
공중으로 맹독성 농포를 비처럼 발사합니다. 농포는 충격 시 피해를 주고,: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.
공중으로 발사된 화살이 목표 지점에 꽂히며 범위 피해를 줍니다. 지면에: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.
공중을 떠도는 타오르는 불씨를 불러냅니다. 불씨는 잠시 후 적을 향해 날: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.
공중을 떠도는 탁탁거리는 우물정령을 불러냅니다. 우물정령은 잠시 후 적을: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.
공중을 조준하고 적을 추적하는 탄두를 발사하여 대상 지역 내 모든 적 근: Aim skyward and fires an enemy-seeking payload which drops a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
구불거리며 천천히 날아가는 화살을 발사해 적을 관통하는 동안 카오스 피해: Fires a slow-moving serpentine arrow which deals chaos damage while piercing enemies, and leaves a trail of caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
권능 또는 인내 충전을 아무 조합으로나 3개 소모하여 장착된 주문을 사용: Consume any combination of 3 Power and/or Endurance Charges to raise a Totem that uses socketed Spells. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 가시 격발을 발동시켜,:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 강력 기절을 더 빨리 축: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 기절을 더 빨리 축적하지: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 아닌 근접 공격으로 적을: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 적을 밀어낼 때 쉬운 표: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 적중하는 적에게 걸린 원소 상태 이상의 수: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Melee Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they hit, but cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 강력 기절하기 직전일수록 보조: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어의 남은 생명력 백분율이 타격한 대: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.
Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.
근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 공격 명중 시 격노를 획득합니다. 플레이어나 보: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.
근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 공격의 물리 피해가 늘어나지만 공격: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.
근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 최근 2초 내에 투사체 공격 명중으로 타격한 경: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 최근 8초 내에 투사체 공격 명중으로 타격한 경: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 출혈 상태의 적에게 주는 피해가 늘어나지만, 공: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.
근접 무기로 적들을 타격해, 물리 피해를 무작위의 원소 피해로 전환합니다: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.
Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.
Strike your foes down with a powerful blow using a melee weapon.
근접 무기에 용암 에너지를 주입하여 공격 시 물리 피해와 화염 피해를 줍: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth causing area attack damage to enemies where they land.
근접 타격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 가시 피해로 보복한 후 보조 대상 스킬이: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.
Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.
근접 타격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 긴 시간 동안 처치하는: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
근접 타격과 바람 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 적을 강력 기절시킬 때: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
근접 타격으로 적들을 공격합니다. 타격은 기절 준비 완료 상태의 적들에게: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.
기절 준비가 된 적들에게 강력 기절을 유발하는 타격입니다. 강력 기절을: A Strike that causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.
기폭 시간이 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 스킬의 기폭 시간과 기폭 피해를 크게: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.
깃발 스킬에 적용되어, 깃발 범위 내의 적들이 원소 저항을 낮추는 디버프: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.
깃발 스킬에 적용되어, 깃발이 생성하는 오라의 영향을 받는 이들에게 굴절: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.
Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.
나비라에게 명령하여 에너지 보호막을 강화합니다. 에너지 보호막 재충전이: Command Navira to bolster your Energy Shield, causing it to begin Recharging immediately and granting you increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate for a duration.
나비라에게 명령하여 위에 적이 서 있는 주변의 모든 얼음 지대를 파열시켜: Command Navira to fracture all nearby areas of Chilled Ground that have enemies standing on them, doing high Spell damage with extreme Freeze potential.
나비라에게 명령하여 주변의 얼음 지대를 나비라의 오아시스로 바꿉니다. 나: Command Navira to turn nearby Chilled Ground into Navira's Oasis, a mirage which grants you and Allies standing in it Flask charges and damage Recouped as Life and Mana. Plants in the area become Overgrown.
나비라에게 명령하여, 보호막 밖에 서 있는 적들이 가하는 피해의 일부를: Command Navira to create a bubble shield which absorbs a portion of the damage dealt by enemies standing outside the shield. The maximum amount of damage that can be absorbed is based on your maximum Mana. If the shield is destroyed by damage, it collapses into a patch of Chilled Ground.
나비라에게 스킬을 사용하라고 명령할 때, 나비라가 회복의 파동을 내보내: When you Command Navira to use a Skill, she also emits a restorative wave that grants you and any other Allies it touches increased Mana Regeneration for a short duration.
나선형으로 돌진하여 무기 피해를 줍니다. 단검과 클로 한손 검으로만 사용: Dive through enemies, dealing weapon damage. Only works with daggers, claws and one handed swords. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.
A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.
날아가면서 파편으로 흩어지며 명중한 적들과 마지막 대상 뒤쪽 작은 부채꼴: Fire flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit, and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.
날아가면서 파편이 되고 적에게 명중하면 연쇄 번개 광선을 방출하는 충전된: Rapidly fire charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. Can fire a limited number of bursts before needing to reload. These fragments can Merge.
Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. These fragments can Merge.
날아가면서 파편이 되는 관통 볼트를 발사합니다. 동결 상태의 적에 명중하: Fire Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of ice shards. These fragments can Merge.
날아가면서 파편이 되는 관통 볼트를 석궁에 장전합니다. 동결 상태의 적에: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.
날아가면서 파편이 되는 얼음 볼트를 발사하여 명중한 적들과 마지막 대상: Fire icy bolts that  fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
날아가면서 파편이 되어 명중한 적들과 마지막 대상 뒤쪽 작은 부채꼴 범위: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.

Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.
낮은 생명력 상태(생명력의 50% 이하 구간)를 보호해 주는 버프를 적용: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.
냉기 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨을 1 추가합니다. 레벨이 없는 스킬에는 적용: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
눈 모양 투사체를 발사합니다. 이 투사체는 파편을 나선형으로 지속하여 방: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.
늑대인간으로 형태 변환하고 목표 지점으로 도약하여, 착지하는 지점 주위의: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.
늑대인간으로 형태 변환하고 발톱을 휘둘러 전방에 달빛과 얼음의 호를 초승: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
늑대인간으로 형태 변환하고, 얼음장 같은 포효를 내질러 적들에게 피해를: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and Freezes Primed enemies. If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
늑대인간으로 형태 변환하여 격노를 달에 바치고 축복을 받아, 플레이어가: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.
늑대인간으로 형태 변환하여 뒤로 도약하면서 양쪽 발톱으로 바닥에 고랑을: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode. immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
늑대인간으로 형태 변환하여 발톱을 마구 휘두릅니다. 첫 공격 시에는 멀리: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.
다른 스킬로 적을 타격하면 연계가 쌓입니다. 최대 연계에 도달한 후 이: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.
다른 스킬로 적을 타격하여 연계를 누적합니다. 최대 연계에 도달하면, 이: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
다른 스킬을 발동시키는 기원 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 최대: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.
다른 스킬을 발동시키는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 발동되는 스: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.
다수의 화살을 허공에 쏘아 잠시 후 대상 지점부터 차례로 떨어지며 사방으: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.
다음으로 사용하는 투사체 스킬이 강화되어, 추가 투사체를 생성하고 더 빨: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.
단일 대상에게 돌진하여 방패로 후려침과 동시에 적을 밀어내고 기절시킵니다: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.
대량의 룬 수호를 소모해 플레이어의 단명하는 분신을 즉시 생성합니다. 이: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.
대상 뒤의 부채꼴 범위에 불타는 폭발을 일으켜 플레이어의 무기에 기반하지: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon
대상 명중 시 부채꼴 범위에 얼음 파편을 흩뿌리는 얼음 화살을 발사합니다: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.
대상 지점에 도달하거나 충돌 시 폭발하는 얼음 투사체를 발사하여 범위 피: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
대상 지점에 별이 떨어져, 충돌 시 범위 피해를 줍니다. 큰 별은 짧은: A star falls at a targeted location, dealing area damage on impact. Larger stars leave Chilled Ground for a short duration.
대상 지점의 지면을 강타합니다. 대상 지점 주위에 적이 있을 경우, 그곳: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground.
Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.
대상에게 달려들어 꿰뚫습니다. 혈액상실을 겪은 적을 명중시키면 피의 폭발: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
대상에게 명중하고 효과 범위가 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 효과 범위를 증가시: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.
대상에게 물리 투사체 하나와 카오스 투사체 하나를 동시에 발사합니다. 이: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.
Inflicts Decay on the target, dealing Chaos Damage over time.
Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target.
대상에게 불타는 투사체를 날립니다. 투사체는 충돌 시 폭발하여 작은 범위: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.
Teleport to a target, dealing Lightning Attack Damage.
대상에게 정전기 감전을 부착합니다. 정전기 감전은 대상과 주변 적들에게: Attaches a Static Shock to a target that pulses Lightning damage to the attached target and nearby enemies. Targets can have a maximum of one Static Shock attached to them.
대상에게 질주하여 육척봉으로 타격합니다. 대상이 감전 상태이면 감전 효과: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
대상에게 징표를 찍습니다. 대상이 받는 다음 치명타 명중이 징표를 활성화: Mark a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives Activates the Mark, Consuming it to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.
대상에게 징표를 찍어 동결에 취약하게 합니다. 징표가 찍힌 대상이 동결되: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
대상에게 징표를 찍어 전기 처형에 취약하게 합니다. 징표가 찍힌 대상이: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
대상에게 징표를 찍어, 대상의 근처에 있는 적의 수에 따라 받는 피해를: Mark a target, causing it to take increased damage based on how many of the target's enemies are near to it. If the target dies, the Mark will Activate to Trigger the Summon Wolf skill and Consume the Mark.
대상을 근접 공격하여 짧은 시간 동안 디버프를 겁니다. 비-고유 적이 디: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.
Covers the target in large quantities of Corrupted Blood which severely damages them.
대상을 명중시키는 번개 스킬에 적용되어 레벨을 1 추가하고, 보조 대상: Supports Lightning skills that Hit targets, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
Covers the target in Corrupted Blood which damages them.
대상을 향해 날아가는 얼어붙은 투사체 여러 개를 생성합니다. 냉각되거나: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.
대상을 향해 치명적인 베기 공격을 가해 플레이어의 무기에 기반하지 않은: Creates a deadly slash towards the target, dealing Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon.
Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.
던진 방패의 위치로 순간이동하여 공중에 나타난 후 방패로 바닥을 강타하여: Teleport to your thrown Shield, appearing in the air and Slamming it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an Ice Crystal with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.
Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
도피와 차원 능력을 제공하는 버프를 부여합니다. 이 버프를 보유한 동안: Grants Elusive and a buff that grants Phasing. While you have this buff, monsters that enter an area around you will be Withered. Using a skill or losing the Elusive buff ends this skill's effects. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be used while already Elusive.
동결, 감전 또는 점화 상태의 적에게 깃든 원소 에너지를 소모하여, 주입: Consume the elemental energy from a Frozen, Shocked or Ignited enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an Infusion Remnant. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same Ailment, but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.
Throw a coin into the air, letting fate decide the outcome.
되돌아와 붙잡을 수 있는 투사체를 발사합니다. 붙잡은 투사체는 칼날 선회: Fires a returning projectile that can be caught. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return.
두 번 베어 적들에게 피해를 주는 힘의 파도를 시전합니다. 핏빛 태세에서: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.
뒤로 공중제비를 넘고 집중을 유지해 육척봉에 번개를 충전합니다. 방출하면: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
뒤쪽으로 공중제비를 넘으며 전방의 적에게 동결의 파도를 내보내, 동결 준: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.
뒤쪽으로 도약하며 지팡이로 지면을 깨트려 얼음 결정을 생성합니다. 결정은: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.
뒤쪽으로 도약하며, 탈출을 시작한 위치 주변의 적들을 냉각 또는 동결시키: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.
등에 실체 없는 종을 부착합니다. 다른 스킬이 치명타 명중하면 종소리가: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.
따로 조작하지 않아도 재장전 시간과 같은 빈도로 최대 한도까지 얼음 볼트: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.
따로 조작하지 않아도, 고갈될 때까지 플레이어에게 명중한 원소 피해를 대: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.
땅에서 고드름이 솟아오르면서 잇달아 작은 폭발을 일으켜 범위 내의 적들에: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
땅에서 화산을 솟아오르게 하여 그 위의 적들에게 피해를 주고 녹아내린 투: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.
The Flock damages enemies around you.
Create a new home for your pet Raccoon.
레벨을 획득할 수 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 보조 대상 스킬과 함께 사용되는: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
레벨이 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨과 퀄리티를 증가시키고 비용과 점유는: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.
루잔에게 대검을 던지라고 명령하여, 대검이 떨어지는 바닥에 위해를 끼치는: Command Ruzhan to hurl his greatsword, spreading hazardous runes on the ground where it lands. If an enemy steps on a rune, it erupts in a fiery tornado that deals Spell damage.
루잔에게 명령하여 적에게 불길의 낙인을 찍습니다. 낙인은 잠시 후, 또는: Command Ruzhan to place a fiery brand on an enemy. After a delay or when Detonated, the brand explodes, dealing Spell damage to enemies caught in the blast.
루잔에게 명령하여 타오르는 불씨의 포화를 두 개 생성하여 전방으로 발사합: Command Ruzhan to conjure two volleys of flaming embers and fire them forward. The embers explode on impact, dealing Spell damage.
루잔에게 목표 지점으로 순간이동하라고 명령합니다. 목표 지점에 도착한 진: Command Ruzhan to teleport to the target location. Upon arrival, the Djinn deals Spell damage to enemies around him then slams his blazing sword into the ground, creating a wave of lava that also deals Spell damage.
룬 수호를 모두 소모하여 일시적 수호결속 시전자들을 소환합니다. 이 소환: Spend all your Runic Ward to summon Temporary Wardbound Casters. These Minions target nearby enemies with damaging Cold Spells.
룬 수호를 모두 소모하여 지속시간이 짧은 버프를 획득합니다. 이 버프가: Spends all your Runic Ward to gain a short-duration Buff that causes you to Block all Blockable Hits and apply Parried to enemies from which you've Blocked a Hit. This Buff is removed if you are Heavy Stunned. While this Buff is active, you cannot be Light Stunned, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.
룬 수호를 사용하여 플레이어의 소환수를 즉시 부활시킵니다. 가장 강력한: Spend Runic Ward to instantly Revive your Minions. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.
룬 수호를 사용해 베리시움 화산을 생성합니다. 이 화산은 처음 분출할 때: Spend Runic Ward to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and Triggers Ice Fragments.
Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage that is not based on your Weapon's damage and apply Electrocution buildup.
룬 수호를 소모하면 영광이 축적됩니다. 영광이 최대치인 동안에는 하늘에서: Build Glory by spending Runic Ward. When you have maximum Glory, you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a Temporary Minion. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Verisium Infusion, if possible, to increase the number of Minions summoned.
룬 수호를 소모하여 마무리 타격 한계치 미만의 적에 대한 명중을 불안정하: Spend Runic Ward to cause a destabilising Hit against an enemy under the Culling Strike Threshold, making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the Culling Strike Threshold.
룬 수호를 소모하여 앞에 전기를 띤 탑 두 개를 세웁니다. 탑 사이에 전: Spend Runic Ward to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and Electrocuting enemies caught between them. Projectiles you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on Hit as Chaining Lightning beams.
룬 수호를 소모하여 적들에게 베리시움 룬으로 저주를 걸어 허약을 유발합니: Spend Runic Ward to Curse enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. Hitting these enemies removes the Curse to Trigger an explosion, Knocking Back nearby enemies and causing more Stun buildup based on the Fragility on the target Hit.
룬 수호를 소모하여, 주변의 바닥에서 피해를 주는 얼음 결정 창이 분출되: Spend Runic Ward to cause damaging Ice-Crystal spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of Cold damage.
룬 수호를 쏟아부어 칼날을 구현합니다. 버프 지속시간 동안 이 칼날들이: Pour your Runic Ward into conjuring blades. For the duration of the Buff, these blades fall on enemies Hit by your Projectile Attacks.
룬 수호를 희생하여 주변 동료들에게 가호를 부여하는 에너지 파동을 내보냅: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.
마나 플라스크 충전을 소모하고 폭발하는 플라스크를 던져 범위 내에 냉기: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Cold Attack damage in an area and inflicting Exposure. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.
마나 플라스크 충전을 소모하고 폭발하는 플라스크를 던져 범위 내에 번개: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.
마나 플라스크 충전을 소모하고 폭발하는 플라스크를 던져 범위 내에 화염: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.
마나 플라스크 충전을 소모하고 폭발하는 플라스크를 던져, 범위 내에 물리: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.
Explodes a Witchtoad to deal spell damage in an area.
마법봉에서 투사체를 발사하여 충돌 지점 주위에 일련의 작은 폭발을 일으킵: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of small explosions surrounding its point of impact, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
Polymorph a party member in town, or a player in your hideout, into an animal.
Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies always count as moving, and have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.
맥동하는 서리 보주를 생성합니다. 맥동할 때마다 주변의 적들에게 원소 노: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
메타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 다른 스킬을 발동시키거나 기원: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.
메타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 에너지를 훨씬 빨리 생성합니다: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.
명령 가능한 소환수에게 적용되어, 플레이어가 보조 대상 소환수에게 명령을: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.
명령 스킬을 보유한 소환수에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 소환수가 사용하는 명: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.
명중 시 격분 충전 효과를 획득합니다. 격분 충전 효과는 공격 속도를 증: Performs an attack that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.
명중 시 일정 범위 내에서 폭발하는 감전시키는 화살을 발사합니다. 적에게: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.
Attacks with a bouncing bomb that explodes on hit.
명중으로 적에게 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용되어, 모든 피해 획득의 원인이: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.
명중으로 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 적을 고정하면: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.
명중한 적에게 강력한 지속 카오스 피해 디버프를 유발하는 투사체를 발사합: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.
모든 권능 충전을 소모하고 원소의 힘을 지배하여, 원소 피해를 획득하고: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
모든 권능 충전을 소모하여 육척봉에 전기를 충전하고 육척봉 공격에 번개: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
모든 스킬에 적용되어, 마나 소모를 생명력 소모로 바꿉니다. 정신력을 점: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.
모든 스킬에 적용되어, 마나 소모의 일부를 생명력 소모로 바꿉니다. 정신: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.
모든 스킬에 적용되어, 비용을 줄여 줍니다. 정신력을 점유하는 스킬에는: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.
Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.
Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.
Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.
모든 원소와 어우러져 플레이어가 명중으로 주는 가장 높은 원소 피해에 따: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.
모든 해골 강탈자를 격앙시켜 지속적으로 생명력을 잃고 피격 시 격노를 얻: Enrage all Skeletal Reavers, causing them to lose life over time and gain Rage on hit.
목표 지역에 갑작스런 냉기 폭발을 일으켜 적에게 피해를 줍니다. 또한 넓: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. This also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
목표 지역에 얼음 볼트를 우박처럼 퍼붓습니다. 향상된 볼트가 생성되어 전: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
목표 지역에 화염 볼트를 폭풍우처럼 퍼붓습니다. 세 가지 유형의 원소 주: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.
목표 지역을 폭격하여 충격 시에 일정 범위 내에 피해를 주는 고뇌의 기운: Unleashes a torrent of anguish that bombard the target area, dealing damage in an area on impact. Does not use Ammunition and can be fired freely until the Requiem ends.
목표 지점 주변의 시신 1구를 폭발시켜 범위 피해를 주고, 주변의 적에게: A corpse near the targeted location explodes, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
목표 지점 주위에 떨어지고 기폭 장치 스킬에 명중하면 폭발하는 충전된 볼: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a Detonator Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
목표 지점 주위의 원형 범위와 4개의 사각형 확장 범위 내에 잃은 마나에: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana.
목표 지점에 조명탄을 발사합니다. 조명탄은 적에게 떨어지면 적에게 부착됩: Fires a flare at a target location, attaching to an enemy if it lands on one, then launches a series of arrow volleys centred around the flare.
목표 지점에 해골 전사를 소환합니다. 소환수는 근접 공격을 사용하고 지속: Summon Skeleton Warrior minions at the targeted location. They use a melee attack and die after a duration. If made aggressive, Skeleton Warriors will also dash towards nearby enemies.
목표 지점으로 신속히 순간이동하며, 플레이어가 몬스터나 지형과 겹쳐질 경: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.
목표 지점으로 신속히 순간이동합니다. \"제자리 공격\" 옵션을 사용할: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
Like monster mortar skill, but leaves a ground effect on impact.
무기가 지속적으로 고통받는 영혼들의 고뇌를 안에 축적합니다. 완전히 충전: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.
무기로 반복해서 방패를 두드려 주위 범위에 피해를 주는 충격파를 일으킵니: Repeatedly hammer your Shield with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose Armour for a duration. While Channelling Resonating Shield, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.
무기로 적을 공격하여 명중시키면 해당 적에게 충전된 디버프를 걸고, 명중: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed, and it deals damage to that and other nearby enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other nearby enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected.
무기를 원형으로 휘둘러 주위에 와류를 불러일으키며 효과 범위 내의 적들을: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.
무기를 휘두르며 돌풍을 생성하여 원거리의 적들을 후려칩니다. 적들은 혼미: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.
무적의 모래의 진 소환수인 켈라리를 소환하여 플레이어의 명을 따르도록 합: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.
무적의 물의 진 소환수인 나비라를 소환해 플레이어의 명을 따르도록 합니다: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.
무적의 불의 진 소환수인 루잔을 소환하여 플레이어의 명을 따르도록 합니다: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.
물로 된 구체를 생성하거나, 기존의 구체를 움직이고 지속 시간을 초기화합: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.
물리 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨을 1 추가합니다. 레벨이 없는 스킬에는 적용: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
물리 피해 일부를 냉기 피해로 전환하여 공격합니다. 적이 동결 상태이고: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If an enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily.
반려수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 반려수 주변의 적들을 실명시키고 점: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.
반려수를 소환하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 해당 반려수가 방대해지고, 플레이어: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.
발동 시 일정 시간 동안 다수의 파도를 방출하는 덫을 투척합니다. 각각의: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst. Modifiers to trap throwing speed affects how frequently it releases waves.
발동 시 폭발하여 주변 적들에게 화염 피해를 주고 용암 지대를 생성하는: Throws multiple traps that explode when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving areas of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through them.
Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.
발동 시 플레이어가 장착한 단검, 클로 또는 한손 검의 복제본 두 개가: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in a circle, each repeatedly damaging enemies they spin through.
발동 장치를 2개 소환합니다. 발동 장치는 플레이어를 따라다니며 적을 향: Summon two Triggerbots which follow you around and run towards enemies.
발사하지 않고도 이미 붙잡은 상태의 투사체를 즉시 그리고 2차 지속시간에: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return.
방대한 마력을 이용해 별들을 속박하여 주변 범위 내의 적을 대상으로, 또: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly Triggering Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.
방어구가 완전히 파괴된 적에게 갈라진 방어구를 부여하는 강력한 관통 볼트: Fire a powerful Piercing bolt that applies Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
방패 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 적을 기절시킬 때 가호를 획득: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.
방패로 적의 공격을 막아내면 방패에 불어넣은 폭풍의 힘을 방출하여 공격자: Enchants your shield with the power of storms, which lashes out to deal arcing lightning damage to attackers when you block them.
방패로 지면을 강타하여 대지의 벽을 세워 올립니다. 적은 벽의 부분을 공: Ram your Shield into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your Slams, Warcries, and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.
방패를 비행 종료 시 돌아오는 투사체로 던집니다. 방패가 날아가는 동안에: Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.
방패를 올려 받는 막아낼 수 있는 모든 공격을 막습니다. 적이 가까이 있: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
방패를 올리는 스킬에 적용되어, 막아낼 시 다른 근접 스킬이 주는 피해를: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.
방패를 휘둘러 전방에 세 갈래의 파동으로 범위 피해를 줍니다. 파동이 겹: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.
버클러를 준비하여 플레이어가 받을 다음 명중을 흘려보내서 명중 피해를 막: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.
번개 상태 이상의 영향을 받는 적에게 명중하면 파동이 방출되어 피해를 주: Load your Crossbow with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Rapidly fire charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
번개 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨을 1 추가합니다. 레벨이 없는 스킬에는 적용: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
번개 피해를 주는 폭발을 방출하여 적을 전기 처형합니다. 가까이 있는 적: Unleash a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies Hit can be Electrocuted by all Lightning damage for a short duration.
번개가 범위 내의 모든 쓰러진 해골을 내리쳐 주위에 감전 지대를 생성합니: Lightning bolts strike all fallen Skeletons in the area, creating Shocked Ground around them.
번개가 탁탁대며 잇달아 작은 폭발을 일으켜 범위 내의 적들에게 피해를 줍: Lightning crackles in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
Fire a Lightning-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by Lightning Ailments. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and Chain towards nearby targets, with those Chaining Hits also releasing a shockwave. After the final Chain, the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. Consumes Shock from enemies it Hits, but not Electrocution.
번개로 충전된 화살을 발사합니다. 적 또는 벽에 명중하면 화살이 주변의: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
번개로 충전된 화살을 발사합니다. 화살은 짧은 시간 동안 이동한 후 방향: Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies.
번개를 띤 찌르기 공격을 가합니다. 이 공격은 최대 3회 연쇄시킬 수 있: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.
범위 내 모든 적에게 저주를 걸어 감속시킵니다. 이때 적에게 걸려 있던: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.
Deals attack damage in an area.
범위 내에 벼락과 폭우를 유발하는 뇌우를 부릅니다. 범위 내의 적들은 흠: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.
범위 내에 플레이어의 가시 피해를 줍니다. 이 스킬이 발동한 원인인 대상: Deal your Thorns Damage in an Area. Cannot Hit the target this was Triggered from.
범위 내에 피해를 주는공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 효과 범: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.
범위 내의 모든 적에게 걸린 저주를 기폭하여 카오스 피해를 주는 폭발을: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.
범위 내의 모든 적에게 저주를 걸어 적 명중 시 쇠잔 상태로 만들고, 낮: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.
범위 내의 적들에게 쇠잔 효과를 시전하여 이동을 방해하고, 누적되는 위축: Casts a debilitating effect on enemies in an area, Hindering their movement and applying a stacking Withered debuff that increases the Chaos Damage they take. This effect can stack up to 15 times.
범위 내의 적들에게 지속 카오스 피해를 주는 디버프를 겁니다. 해당 적들: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
범위 또는 적을 대상으로 지정하고, 범위 내에 맥동하는 번개 파동 피해를: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing Lightning damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final Lightning strike.
범위 또는 적을 대상으로 지정하고, 일정 범위를 타격하는 거대 유성을 떨: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing Fire damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.
범위 또는 적을 대상으로 지정하고, 일정 시간 동안 범위 내에 얼어붙은: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a series of icy hailstones to rain down in an area over a duration.
별도의 조작 없이 지속적으로 봉인을 획득합니다. 이 스킬을 사용하면 투사: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.
병독성 화살을 발사하여, 명중 시 독성 폭발을 일으키고 범위 내의 모든: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.
보조 대상 스킬로 생성된 얼음 결정 주위에 확산되는 얼음 지대를 생성합니: Creates spreading Chilled Ground around Ice Crystals created by Supported Skills.
Creates multiple Fissures when landing with Supported Skill.
보조 대상 스킬이 생성하는 산산이 조각난 물체에서 달리는 돌 소환수가 생: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.
보조 대상 스킬이 원소 지대 효과로 향상될 때 발동되어 해당하는 원소 피: Triggered when supported skill is boosted by an Elemental Ground Surface to deal damage of the matching Element.
보조 대상 스킬이 점화, 감전 또는 동결을 소모할 때 발동되어, 소모한: Triggered when supported skill Consumes Ignite, Shock, or Freeze, to deal damage of Types matching the Consumed Ailments.
볼트를 고속으로 발사하여 적의 방어구를 파괴합니다. 볼트는 제한된 개수만: Rapidly fire bolts that Break enemy Armour. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
부활 능력이 있는 반려수를 소환하여 전투를 돕게 합니다. 용병은 장착된: Summon a Reviving Companion to aid you in combat. The Mercenary will use socketed Attacks, and can be given equipment in the Skills Panel.
Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.
부활하는 소환수를 소환하는 소환수 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 소환수가: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.
부활하는 유지형 소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 이들 소환수가 사망: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.
불꽃에서 힘을 얻는 폭발성 얼음 파도를 방출합니다. 파도는 피해를 주지: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto Ignited enemies, refreshing the duration of their active Ignite and rapidly Freezing them but preventing them from being Ignited further until the Ignite expires.
불안정한 볼트를 석궁에 장전합니다. 이 볼트는 오랫동안 충전해야 발사할: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
불타는 괴물로 형태 변환하고 공중으로 도약했다가 바닥에 내려앉으며 두 번: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.
불타는 구체를 던집니다. 구체는 지면에 부딪히면 범위 피해를 줍니다. 스: Lob a fiery orb that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skill Chains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. The number of  Chains is refreshed when passing through a Flame Wall.
불타는 망치를 던집니다. 망치는 바닥을 강타하고 바닥에 꽂힙니다. 망치가: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.
불타는 보호막을 소환하여 잠시 동안 방어도를 증가시킵니다. 효과가 지속되: Summons fiery elemental shields providing additional armour for a short duration. If cumulative physical damage prevented by your blocking or armour reaches a threshold, the shields explode outwards, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.
불타는 유령이 적에게 달려들어 피해를 줍니다. 유령은 적의 공격을 통과합: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
불타는 폭발이나 지직거리는 번개, 얼어붙은 투사체의 파동 등을 방출합니다: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.
Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.
Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.
비-상태 이상 지속 카오스 피해를 주는 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
비-상태 이상 지속 카오스 피해를 주는 주문에 적용됩니다. 스킬로 주는: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
비-상태 이상 지속 피해를 주는 주문에 적용됩니다. 스킬의 지속시간이 짧: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.
비-상태 이상 지속 피해를 주는 주문에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 지속 피해 디: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.
비무장 근접 공격으로 명중하면, 번개가 떨어지며 주변의 모든 적들에게 비: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.
비무장 근접 공격이 명중하면, 얼음장 같은 바람을 내보내 주변의 모든 적: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.
비전 에너지의 폭풍을 생성하고 폭풍 안에 머무는 동안 마나를 소모하는 주: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.
비취 중첩을 모두 소모하여, 소모한 비취 수에 따라 최대 생명력의 일정: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.
Direct your flying companion to eviscerate another player's pet.
Fire an icy bolt that creates two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of its flight.
비행 종료 시 얼음 결정 벽 2개를 생성하는 얼음 볼트를 석궁에 장전합니: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.
비행 종료 시 폭발하여 작은 범위에 있는 적들에게 화염 피해를 주는 화염: Launches a ball of fire which explodes at the end of its flight, damaging foes in a small area.
빛이 없는 심연에서 솟아오르는 끔찍한 해골을 소환하여 적들을 물어뜯어 목: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
빠르게 볼트를 연속 발사합니다. 이 스킬은 탄약 개수가 제한됩니다. 탄약: Fires bolts in rapid succession. The skill has limited ammunition. This ammunition will reload when using a bolt skill, or automatically when bolts are depleted.
빠른 얼음 타격을 수행합니다. 이 공격을 빠르게 3번 연속 사용하면 마지: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.
뼈 가시로 해골을 꿰뚫어 가시가 남아 있는 동안 소환수를 보호하여, 명중: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
뾰족한 얼음 조각을 연이어 쏘아냅니다. 쏘아진 얼음 조각은 잠시 동안 천: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
사용 시 권능, 격분 또는 인내 충전을 소모하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.
사용되지 않은 시체를 폭발시켜, 주변의 적들에게 화염 피해를 줍니다. 주: Explodes an unused corpse, dealing fire damage to nearby enemies. Nearby corpses will also explode in a chain reaction. The explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
사용하는 데 연계가 필요한 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 연계를: Supports Skills which require Combo to use. Supported Skills lose their Combo stacks after a longer delay spent not gaining any Combo.
사용할 수 있는 모든 스킬에 적용되어, 플레이어가 스킬을 사용하는 동안: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.
사용할 수 있는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 스킬을 사용하는 동안: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.
Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.
산산조각 날 수 있는 흙 물체를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 이 물체의: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.
상대에게 돌진하여 방패로 후려침과 동시에 적을 밀어내고 기절시킵니다. 해: Charges at an enemy, bashing it with the character's shield and striking it. This knocks it back and stuns it. Enemies in the way are pushed to the side. Damage and stun are proportional to distance travelled. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.
생명력의 일부를 희생하여 룬 수호를 회복합니다. 이 스킬로 회복되는 룬: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.
생명력이 일정 기준 미만인 아군 소환수를 기폭시켜 주변의 적들에게 큰 공: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.
석궁 스킬에 적용되어, 마지막 6초 동안 그 스킬로 재장전한 볼트의 개수: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.
석궁 스킬에 적용되어, 적 처치 시 모든 석궁 탄약에 볼트가 1개 장전되: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.
석궁 스킬에 적용되어, 지난 8초 동안 그 스킬로 재장전한 볼트의 개수에: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.
석궁 탄약 스킬에 적용되어, 발사 시 일정 확률로 볼트를 소모하지 않게: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.
석궁 탄약 스킬에 적용되어, 여러 개의 추가 볼트를 장전하고 더 빨리 공: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.
석궁 탄약 스킬에 적용되어, 재장전 속도를 희생하고 발사 시 일정 확률로: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.
석궁 탄약 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 공격 속도와 볼트 용량이: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.
석궁 탄약 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 적을 강력 기절시킬 때 자동으로 재: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
석궁 탄약 스킬에 적용됩니다. 재장전 속도를 희생하여 추가 볼트를 장전합: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
Fire a bolt from your crossbow.
석궁의 모든 탄약 탄창을 즉시 재장전하고, 각 탄창의 탄약을 강화하여 일: Instantly reload all your Crossbow Ammunition clips and Empower each clip's Ammunition to deal more damage for a duration.
소모된 점화의 예상 피해의 일정 비율에 따라 일정 범위 내에 화염 피해를: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.
소모된 출혈의 예상 피해의 일정 비율에 따라 일정 범위 내에 물리 피해를: Deal Physical Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Bleeding.
소환수 생성 스킬에 적용됩니다. 가능한 경우, 소환수를 대상으로 지정하는: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.
Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.
소환수 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨을 1 추가합니다. 레벨이 없는 스킬에는 적: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
소환수 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 소환수가 주는 피해가 커지고 명령: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
소환수 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 소환수의 명령 스킬 재사용 대기시간: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 해당 소환수가 피해를 주거나 받지 못: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 해당 소환수의 원소 저항을 강화합니다: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 소환수가 낮은 생명력 상태가 되면: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.
소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 소환수가 받는 피해가 줄어들지만 주: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.
Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 소환수가 주는 피해와 받는 피해가: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
소환수를 소환하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 소환해 둔 부활 소환수의 유형이 많: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.
The minion's shield of bone explodes, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
소환수의 생명력을 희생하여 주변 지역에 카오스 피해를 줍니다. 소환수가: Sacrifice the life of a Minion to deal Chaos damage in an area around it. If you have no Minions, your own life is sacrificed instead.
Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.
쇄도하는 비전 에너지를 생성하여 마나를 회복합니다. 활성화된 동안 플레이: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.
쇠뇌 토템을 배치하여 공중으로 볼트를 발사합니다. 볼트는 떨어지고 잠시: Deploy a Ballista Totem that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.
Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.
수사슴의 혼백을 불러내, 전방으로 뛰어나가게 합니다. 수사슴은 각각 착지: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind Shocked Ground.
수호를 소모하고 일정 범위를 대상으로 지정하여, 시신을 원통한 핵으로 변: Spend Ward and target an area, transforming Corpses into bitter cores that seek out enemies and Chill enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional Cold damage over time.
수호를 소모해 모든 원소 주입 대신 사용할 수 있는 베리시움 주입을 생성: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.
순수하고 예측 불가능한 원소 힘의 흐름에 접촉하여 무작위로 선택된 원소로: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.
Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.
시신 또는 권능 충전을 소모하여 단명하는 좀비 하나를 소환합니다. 권능: Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.
