시신에 부정한 룬으로 징표를 남겨 주변의 적들에게 지속 카오스 피해를 줍: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.
Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
시신을 소모하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 일정 확률로 시신을 파괴하지: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.
시신을 소모하여 가연성 독성 가스 구름을 생성합니다. 모든 화상 효과 또: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.
시신을 소모하여 적을 추적하고 주변의 적들을 점화하는 폭발성 중심부를 생: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.
시신을 소모할 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 시신을 소모: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.
시신이 폭발하여 범위 피해를 주고, 분화구가 되어 일정 시간 동안 주변: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash exploding projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
시전 시 룬 명문을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 룬 명문이 만료될 때 용암: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.
시전자 곁에 머무는 신성한 유물을 소환합니다. 공격이 적에게 명중 시,: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell, with a very short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions.
Fire an arc of knives in front of the caster which deals physical damage.
시전자 주위에 냉기의 소용돌이를 일으켜 적에게 피해를 줍니다. 또한 주변: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area.
Launches a series of fireballs in a spiral around the caster.
시전자 주위에 얼음 폭발을 일으켜 냉기 피해를 줍니다. 또한 소용돌이를: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will explode from a number of those projectiles instead, destroying them.
시전자가 받는 물리 피해를 감소시켜주는 카오스 골렘을 소환합니다. 카오스: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you Physical Damage Reduction. The Chaos Golem can use a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.
Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage. The Flame Golem can use a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.
시전자로부터 대상 적에게 원호 형태로 번개가 뻗어 나가 주변의 다른 적들: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Shocked enemies Hit release damaging pulses.
시전자로부터 지정된 적에게 원호 형태로 번개가 뻗어 나가 주변의 적들에게: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.
시전자로부터 지정된 적에게 충격을 주는 번개 줄기가 뻗어 나가 주변의 적: A shocking arc of lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other nearby enemies. Each time the beam chains it will also chain simultaneously to a second enemy, but no enemy can be hit twice by the beams. Also grants a buff making you lucky when damaging enemies with Arc for a short duration.
시전자에게 방어도를 추가하는 버프를 적용하여, 고갈되기 전까지 피격 시: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
시전자에게 생명력 재생 능력을 부여하는 돌 골렘을 소환합니다. 돌 골렘은: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.
시전자와 동료들에게 물리 피해에 따른 냉기 피해를 부여하는 오라를 시전합: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.
시전자와 동료들에게 원소 저항과 원소 상태 이상 면역을 부여하는 오라를: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies.
시전자와 동료들에게 이동 속도 및 공격 속도, 시전 속도를 증가시키는 오: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.
시전자와 동료들에게 주문 피해와 주문 치명타 확률을 증가시키는 오라를 시: Casts an aura that grants bonuses to damage and critical strike chance of spells to you and your allies, and gives a chance to create Consecrated Ground against stronger enemies.
시전자와 동료들의 공격 시 번개 피해를 추가하고, 주문 사용 시 번개 피: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.
Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.
Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.
시전자와 동료들이 주는 지속 피해를 증폭시키고 스킬 효과의 지속시간을 증: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.
시전자의 공격 및 시전 속도를 증가시키는 번개 골렘을 소환합니다. 번개: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased Attack and Cast speed. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
시전자의 마나 일부를 소모하는 대신 고갈될 때까지 피격 시 받는 피해의: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
시전자의 방어도를 높여주고 고갈되기 전까지 피격 시 받는 피해의 일부를: Applies a buff that raises your armour, and takes some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Each second, the skill deals reflected damage to surrounding enemies based on the damage taken by the buff in that second. When the buff is removed, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken by the buff. You cannot have the buff at the same time as any other Guard skill.
시전자의 생명력과 에너지 보호막을 희생하여, 주변의 적들을 마법 불꽃으로: Engulfs you in magical fire that rapidly burns you and nearby enemies. Your spell damage is substantially increased while under this effect. The effect ends when you have 1 life remaining.
시전자의 총 에너지 보호막과 생명력을 일부 희생하여, 일정 시간 동안 주: Sacrifices a portion of your Life and Energy Shield to engulf you in magical fire that rapidly burns nearby enemies for a duration. Your spell damage is increased while under this effect.
시전자의 치명타 확률과 정확도를 증가시켜주는 얼음 골렘을 소환합니다. 얼: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning dash in addition to its melee attack.
Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.
식물 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 과성장한 후 폭발을 발동시키고 명중하는: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.
신성한 날개를 타고 공중으로 도약하여, 착지하는 곳에 있는 적들에게 창으: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a Fragment of Divinity near you or the targeted location, this attack will Consume it when you leap to become Empowered, dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.
신성화 지대를 만들어 그 안에 있는 플레이어와 동료에게 적용되는 저주의: Creates an area of Consecrated Ground, providing life regeneration and reducing the effect of curses for you and allies who stand in it.
심연의 낫을 생성하고 목표 지역을 휩쓸어 적들에게 화염 피해를 주고 점화: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.
Conjure Abyssal spirits to Hinder a Rare Undead for a duration. If you defeat the Undead while it is Hindered, it will be captured and stored into a Soul Crystal Skill Gem. The Soul Crystal will allow a wielder of great Abyssal power to summon the bound Undead as a Reviving Companion.
아군 플레이어를 대상으로 지정하여 일정 시간 동안 자신과 연결하는 버프를: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
아무 스킬에나 마나를 사용해 연료를 얻은 후, 모은 연료를 사용해 손에서: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.
The Azmerian Wolf howls, reaching out to the spirits to begin an Eternal Hunt. While the Eternal Hunt persists, spirits manifest as spectral wolves to ambush foes, damaging and Maiming enemies they Hit before disappearing.
아즈메리 도깨비불을 불러내 일정 시간 동안 희귀 야수를 휩싸게 하여 이동: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

앞으로 기어가며 경로에 있는 적들에게 피해를 주는 뿌리로 묶인 균열을 불: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
양손의 무기로 한번에 공격하여 피해를 줍니다. 쌍수를 사용해야 하며 마법: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

얼음 결정을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 생성되는 얼음 결정의 생명력을 높: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

얼음 결정을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 가능한 경우: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.
얼음 결정을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 얼음 결정을: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Supported Skills create chilling areas which deal Cold Damage over time instead of creating Ice Crystals.

얼음 파동이 모든 방향으로 퍼져나가, 적들이 플레이어와 근접해 있는 정도: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. 얼음의 벽을 생성하여 적을 저지합니다. 방벽이 생성되는 위치에 있던 적들: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.
Fires multiple arrows at different targets.
여섯 번 연속으로 빠른 찌르기 공격을 수행합니다. 마지막 찌르기가 출혈을: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. 연계 공격 끝에 최후 타격을 가하는 타격에 적용됩니다. 최후 타격을 연속: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.
Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.
연계 공격 끝에 최후 타격을 가하는 타격에 적용됩니다. 최후 타격이 가한: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.
연계 공격 끝에 최후 타격을 가하는 타격에 적용됩니다. 최후 타격이 선대: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.
연계를 소진할 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 연계를 소진: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

연속 가능 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문이 대상 범위에서 무작위로: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.
Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.
연속적인 공격적 타격을 수행합니다. 빠르게 연속해서 사용하면 세 번째에는: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.
Direct your permanent minions to attack a target or move to a location.
예측 불가능한 관통성 돌개바람 투사체를 발사합니다. 돌개바람은 일정 시간: Launches an unpredictable, piercing twister projectile that moves randomly for a duration, repeatedly dealing damage to enemies it intersects.
Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.
와이번으로 형태 변환하고 강력한 날갯짓을 해서 뒤로 날아가며 적들을 밀어: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. 와이번으로 형태 변환하고 시신 또는 마무리 타격이 가능한 적과 주변의 추: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. 와이번으로 형태 변환하여 마그마 구체를 던집니다. 구체는 지면에 부딪히면: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skillChains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on Molten Fissures or Volcanos will activate them as though they were Slammed.
완벽한 타이밍에 방출하면 특수 효과를 발휘하는 집중 유지 스킬에 적용됩니: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

원하는 지점으로 도약 후 착지하면서 무기로 적들에게 피해를 주며 밀쳐 냅: Jump into the air, damaging enemies (and knocking back some) with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way.

위에서 화살을 비처럼 쏟아부어 떨어진 지점에 가연성 독성 가스 구름을 생: Rain an arrow down from above, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas where it lands. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.

위해 요소를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 생성된 위해: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

유탄 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 유탄이 튕기지 않고 처음 떨어: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

Sweep your Quarterstaff, projecting a bolt of Lightning through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.

이 스킬은 포식자의 징표가 활성화될 때 발동되어, 죽을 때까지 플레이어를: This skill is Triggered when Predator's Mark Activates to Summon a Wolf Minion that follows you as long as it lives.
이 주문은 재사용 횟수를 여러 번 소모하여 얼음 조각상을 원형으로 소환합: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing.

이 폭발을 발동시킨 대상의 파괴된 방어구에 따라 물리 범위 피해를 줍니다: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the Broken Armour of the target which this explosion was Triggered from.
A Slam that causes Aftershocks when hitting an Immobilised enemy.

Deal Chaos damage in an area around the previously Cursed enemy.

인도하는 아즈메리 혼백들에게 선택받아, 주변의 고대 꽃을 볼 수 있게 됩: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.
일정 개수의 다른 스킬을 강화할 수 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 더 많은 스킬: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.
일정 개수의 화염의 화살이 소용돌이 모양으로 쏟아지며 목표 지점에 충돌하: A fixed number of flaming bolts rain down in a spiral, culminating in the central one impacting the targeted location. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and leaving burning ground, which deals fire damage over time.
일정 시간 동안 목표 지점에 정지 상태의 화염, 냉기 또는 번개 폭풍을: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.
일정 시간 동안 영향을 받은 모든 적의 시간을 정지시키는 커다란 파도를: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.
일정 시간 동안 천상의 칼날이 주변을 회전하며 칼날에 스치는 적들에게 반: An ethereal blade spins around you for a duration, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.
일정 시간이 경과한 후에 기폭되는 스킬에 적용되어, 기폭 전의 시간을 단: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.
일정 시간이 경과한 후에 기폭되는 스킬에 적용되어, 기폭 전의 시간을 크: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.
일정 조건을 충족해야 사용할 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 조건을 충족한: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.
일정 횟수 명중당한 후 파괴되는 물체를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 물체가: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
일직선으로 벽을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 벽이 균열을 따라 생성되게 합: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.
일직선으로 벽을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 벽이 원형으로 생성되지만,: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.
Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.
Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.
자신 외의 스킬들을 강화하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 강화받: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.
Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to deal more damage.
자신의 무기에 쇄도를 부여합니다. 이 무기로 가하는 비-근접 투사체 공격: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.
자신의 분열된 모방물을 생성합니다. 모방물은 이를 발동시킨 주문을 시전한: Creates a Fractured Mimic of yourself, suspended in time at the point of casting the Triggering Spell. If you reach the Limit of Fractured Mimics, they will all finish casting their Spells and disappear.
자신의 피를 뽑아서 일정 시간 동안 버프를 유지합니다. 이 버프가 있으면: Draws out your own blood to power a buff for a duration, letting this skill inflict the Corrupted Blood debuff on enemies you hit, dealing physical damage over time for a short secondary duration. The buff's duration will be refreshed if you spend enough life before it expires.
자신의 피를 전방 부채꼴 범위에 연쇄 피 촉수로 방출합니다. 촉수가 명중: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.
작은 폭발이 연속으로 일어나며 지면에서 고드름이 솟아올라 범위 내의 적들: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.
잔류물을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 생성되는 잔류물을 더 강력하게 만듭니: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.
Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.
잔류물을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 잔류물을 더 멀리서 획득하고 일정 확: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.
잔류물을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 잔류물을 더 멀리서 획득할 수 있게: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.
잔류물을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 해당 잔류물 획득 시 플레이어 대신: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.
잔류물을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 생성된 잔류물을: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.
Whack another exile with your severed arm.
잠깐의 준비 시간 후 원거리 무기로 빠르게 연속 사격합니다. 이 공격은: After a short preparation time, you attack repeatedly with a ranged weapon. These attacks have a small randomised spread. Only works with Bows and Wands. This skill cannot be Triggered.
잠시 동안 퓨즈 역할을 하는 화살을 발사합니다. 같은 적에게 폭발 화살을: Fires an arrow which acts as a short duration fuse. Applying additional arrows to an enemy extends the duration. When the target dies or the fuses expire, the arrows explode, dealing fire AoE damage to nearby enemies. The AoE radius is proportional to the number of arrows upon death.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Cold Resistance.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Lightning Resistance.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Fire Resistance.
잠시 후 범위 내 모든 대상에게 저주를 걸어, 대상에 대한 명중이 방어도: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.
잠시 후 범위 내의 모든 적에게 디버프를 걸어, 적이 명중으로 받는 피해: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.
잠시 후 폭발하여 처치한 동결된 적의 생명력에 따라 범위 내에 냉기 피해: Explodes to deal Cold Damage in an area after a short delay, based on the life of the slain frozen Enemy.
장비한 근접 무기의 형태 복제품을 투척합니다. 무기는 나선형으로 날아가며: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spirals out in a spinning attack that strikes enemies in its path.
장비한 근접 무기의 형태 복제품을 투척합니다. 무기는 날아갔다가 되돌아오: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.
장비한 근접 무기의 형태 복제품을 투척합니다. 무기는 큰 나선을 그리면서: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.
장전된 볼트를 모두 하늘로 발사하여, 대상 지역의 중앙에서 시작해 바깥으: Fire all loaded bolts into the sky, causing them to rain down over the target area, starting at the centre and spreading outward.
장착된 오라 주문을 모두 시전합니다. 자신에게 적용되지 않습니다. 적에게: Casts all socketed aura spells. They will not apply to you. Auras that only apply to enemies cannot be socketed.
장착된 징표 스킬을 몇 초마다 주변의 징표가 없는 적에게 적용합니다. 장: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.
Place a ballista totem which uses the socketed bow or wand attack skills.
장착한 유탄 스킬을 사용하며 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도가 크게 향상된 대: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.
장착한 저주 스킬을 끔찍한 오라로 바꾸어, 주변의 모든 적들에게 해당 효: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
재사용 대기시간이 있는 비-즉시 스킬에 적용되어, 재사용 횟수를 2회 추: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.
재사용 대기시간이 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 재사용 횟수를 추가해 주고 스킬: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
재사용 대기시간이 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 넘치: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.
재사용 대기시간이 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 재사용 대기시간이 회복되는 속: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
저장된 소환수의 생명력을 소모하여 소환수를 부활시킵니다. 총 최대 생명력: Consume stored Minion Life to Revive your Minions. Revives as many Minions as possible with total maximum Life equal to or less than the Life stored by Grim Feast, prioritising those with higher maximum Life.
Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.
저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬에 짧은 재사용 대기시간이 생기지: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.
저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 저주에 걸린 적들이 보조 대상: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.
저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 안에 있는 적에게 저주를 거는: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Skills create an area which Curses Enemies within it, and spawns Witchtoads in that area. Witchtoads leap at enemies that get close, and seek out Cursed enemies with higher aggression. Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.
저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 저주를 거는 각 대상에게 부정: Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.
저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 저주 스킬이 일정 범위를 생성하여 그: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.
저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 더 넓은 지역에 적용되지만 적을 저주하는: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.
Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.
저주받은 대상 주변의 일정 범위 내에 플레이어의 무기 피해에 기반하지 않: Deals Physical Attack damage in an area around the Cursed target that is not based on your Weapon's damage. Other targets are Knocked back and take more Stun buildup based on the Fragility they have.
Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.
적 안에 화염의 씨앗을 심습니다. 적에게 일정량 이상 피해를 주거나 적을: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.
적 하나를 대상으로 지정합니다. 대상이 마무리 타격 범위에 드는 경우 대: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.

Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.
적들 사이에 연쇄되는 맹독성 투사체를 발사합니다. 투사체는 무기별로 달라: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies.
적들에게 구멍을 뚫어 출혈 디버프를 일으키며, 이는 스킬 지속시간 관련: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with bows, daggers, claws or swords.
적들에게 명중하지 않는 눈 투사체를 1개 발사합니다. 눈은 나선을 그리며: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.
적들에게 반복해서 순간이동하고 그들을 명중하여 상처를 유발하지만 피해는: Repeatedly teleports to enemies and hits them, inflicting a wound but dealing no damage. After the repeating finishes, each enemy is hit by the total damage of their wounds, which are removed.
적들에게 카오스 피해를 주어 영광을 축적합니다. 영광이 최대치일 때는 몽: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.
Summon a short-lived Verisium Manifestation that launches Projectile Attacks at enemies.
적들에게 화상을 주는 화염 광선을 시전합니다. 광선 속 적들은 화상이 심: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam intensifies the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam can turn.
적들을 끌어당기고 번개 피해를 파동으로 방출하여, 명중당한 적들의 이동을: Pull enemies in and pulse Lightning damage, Hindering enemies Hit. Each pulse increases in damage, with the final pulse dealing additional damage.
적들을 빨아들이고 지속 물리 피해를 주는 폭풍을 생성합니다. 원소 지대: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.
적들을 원소 피해로 명중하여 영광을 축적합니다. 영광이 최대일 때, 일정: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.
Conjure a Chaos tornado that chases down and Slows enemies.
적들을 추적하는 관통 투사체를 발사합니다. 명중한 적에게는 짧은 시간 동: Fire a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.
적들의 취약한 순간을 이용하는 시간의 폭발을 방출합니다. 기절, 전기 처: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.
적에 의해 발동하면 힘줄 절단을 유발하고 공격 범위 피해를 줍니다. 마름: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.
적에게 노출을 적용하는 스킬에 적용되어, 적용되는 노출의 효과를 증가시킵: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.
적에게 동결, 감전, 점화를 유발하여 영광을 축적합니다. 영광이 최대일: Build Glory by inflicting Freeze, Shock or Ignite on enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your Spear in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding Ignited Ground. Modifiers to number of Projectiles fired do not apply to this skill.
적에게 맹독성 농포를 부착합니다. 농포는 일정 시간 후 기폭되어 공격 피: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which Detonates after a delay, dealing Attack damage. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.
적에게 명중하거나 만료될 때까지 천방지축으로 움직이는 전기불꽃 분사 투사: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.
적에게 명중하는 스킬에 적용되어, 동결된 적을 처치할 때 얼음 파편을 생: Supports Skills that Hit enemies, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
적에게 명중하여 폭발할 때까지 무작위로 움직이는 예측 불가능한 전기불꽃을: Continuously launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
적에게 순간이동하여 타격합니다. 권능 충전을 소모하여 추가로 순간이동하고: Teleport to an enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.
적에게 질주하여 공격으로 타격하고, 냉기의 파도를 방출하여 주변의 적들을: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.
적에게 질주하여 돌파하면서, 적의 생명력이 낮을 경우 마무리 타격을 가합: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.
적에게 질주하여 타격하고, 장착된 징표를 효과가 증가한 상태로 발동시키고: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.
적에게 질주하여 타격하고, 적의 생명력이 낮을 경우 마무리 타격을 가합니: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

적을 명중하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 출혈 상태인 적을 명중하면 준 물리 피: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Hobble Bleeding Enemies based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
적을 명중하는 식물 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 적 명중 시 맹: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.
적을 명중하는 이동 전용 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 생명력이: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.
적을 명중하는 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 물리 피해로 적에게: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.
적을 명중하는 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문의 피해가 커지지만, 치: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.
적을 명중할 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 명중으로 적을: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.
적을 명중할 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 명중으로 적이: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.
적을 점화하여 얻은 영광을 사용해 함성을 내질러, 카옴의 화신으로 변합니: Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.
적을 중독시킬 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 중독된 적이 시간이 지남에 따: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
적을 추적하는 탄두를 석궁에 장전하고 공중으로 발사하여 대상 지역 내 모: Load your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.
적을 향해 질주하여 적의 저항을 무효화합니다. 원소 저항이 양수인 적을: Dash to an enemy and nullify their Resistance. Hitting an enemy with positive Elemental Resistance will reduce their highest Elemental Resistance to 0 for a duration and triggers Infuse Weapon, granting your Spear the maximum possible Surges corresponding to the removed Resistance. If this skill doesn't remove any Resistances, its cooldown is reset. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
적을 향해 질주한 후 짓찢는 베기를 수행하여, 적중당한 모든 적에게 출혈: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.
적의 등 뒤에서 공격할 경우 치명타를 가하여 단일 적에게 추가 피해를 주: A dagger skill that deals a critical strike and additional damage to an enemy if the attack is made from behind the enemy. Has high mana cost and cooldown.
적의 생기를 뽑아내려 합니다. 마무리 타격 범위 내의 적들이 강조 표시되: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.
The enemy's Corpse violently explodes, dealing Fire damage in an area around it.
적의 심장에 심연 에너지의 씨앗을 심습니다. 적에게 일정량 이상 피해를: Plant a seed of Abyssal Energy on the enemy's heart. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes their heart to explode, dealing Physical damage in an area.
적의 피를 마셔 생명력을 회복합니다. 활성화된 동안 플레이어가 적을 처치: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.
적이 범위 내에 들어올 때 폭발하여 카오스 피해를 주고, 명중 시 보조: Explodes and deals Chaos Damage when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported Curse on Hit.
적중당한 적으로부터 용암 투사체를 발사합니다. 투사체는 가까운 곳에 떨어: Fires molten Projectiles from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing Attack damage in an area.
전기 보주를 생성하여 주변 적들에게 연쇄 번개를 방출합니다. 보주는 만료: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
전기를 띤 창을 던집니다. 창은 바닥에 꽂힌 후 주변 적들을 주기적으로: Throw an electrified Spear that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with Lightning bolts. If the Spear is Detonated by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create Shocked Ground on Detonation.
전령 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬의 발동형 효과가 주는 피해가 커지지만, 대: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.
전방 부채꼴 범위에 번개를 불러내 모든 적을 명중합니다. 감전된 적에게: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.
전방에 대지로부터 솟아나오는 뼈 가시를 세워 적들에게 피해를 줍니다. 범: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.
전방에 석화의 조각상을 만들어, 응시를 이용해 완전히 석화될 때까지 적들: Creates a Petrification Statue in front of you, which will slow enemies with its gaze, until they become fully petrified.
전방으로 도약하고 지면을 강타하여 충격파를 내보냅니다. 충격파는 혼미한: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
전방으로 돌진하여 대지에 균열을 생성하고 걸음을 옮길 때마다 요철 지대를: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of Jagged Ground with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping Slam damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of Jagged Ground to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of Attack speed.
전방의 긴 지역에 있는 적에게 번개 피해를 주고, 여러 개의 작은 광선으: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.
전방의 대상들에게 피해를 줍니다. 화상을 입은 적들은 더 많은 피해를 줍: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
전방의 지면을 강타하여 정면으로 뻗어나가며 적들에게 피해를 주는 대지의: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies.
Create Ignited Ground Igniting Enemies based on a percentage of your Maximum Mana.
Chills all enemies in your Presence.
접근해 있는 적들이 주기적으로 피 종기를 축적합니다. 적이 죽을 때 종기: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.
제자리에서 회전 공격을 가해 근접한 적에게 피해를 주고 그 밖의 적들을: Spin and attack in place, damaging nearby enemies and pulling others towards you. While using this skill, you cannot be stunned or knocked back. Cannot be supported by Ruthless.
제한이 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 제한을 2배로 늘려 주지만 보조 대상 스킬: Supports Skills which have a Limit, doubling that Limit, but Cursing yourself on Supported Skill use. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit". Cannot support Persistent Skills.
제한이 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 제한을 늘려 주고 대신 지속시간을 줄입니다: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".
주 근접 무도 무기의 복제품을 불멸의 반려수로 현현시켜 시전자의 편에서: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.
주기적으로 화염 파동을 방출하는 화염 보주를 생성합니다. 보주에 아주 가: Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.
주는 물리 피해를 증폭시키는 버프를 부여하며, 효과를 받는 동안 적을 처: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack.
주문 스킬에 적용됩니다. 마나가 최대 마나의 90% 위일 때 보조 대상: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
주문 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 마나 비용 효율이 증가하고 마: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
주문에 적용되어, 주문이 최근 8초 내에 시전한 각기 다른 주문의 수만큼: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.
Create an area of Consecrated Ground around you.
주변의 시신을 소모하여, 소모한 시신의 수에 따라 짧은 시간에 걸쳐 생명: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.
주변의 시체 하나당 두 마리의 영체 거미가 소환되어 맹독 타격으로 적들을: Raise two spectral spiders from each nearby corpse that will attack your enemies with Viper Strike. Each raised spider grants you increased Attack Speed and increased Damage with Poison. Enemies will not engage the spiders directly, and they are immune to damage.
주위 지면을 강타하여 주변의 적들에게 반복적으로 피해를 주는 토템을 세웁: Raise a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it. The Totem cannot create Jagged Ground. This Skill can be used while Shapeshifted.
주위에 고리 형태의 뼈 가시를 세웁니다. 가시는 적과 접촉하면 파괴되며: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
주위에 균열을 생성하여 주변 차율라의 화염을 볼 수 있게 합니다. 이 스: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.
Slam the ground around you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
주위의 지면에 맹독성 꽃의 영역을 생성합니다. 꽃 안에 있는 동안에는 스: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your Projectile Attacks attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be Poisoned. Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.
죽음의 대천사 베이다트의 상을 소환합니다. 이 존재는 전투와 상관이 없습: Summon an image of Beidat, Archangel of Death. This is a non-combat entity.
죽지 않는 무광의 추적자 소환수를 소환합니다. 무광의 추적자는 명중 시: Summons an immortal Lightless Stalker Minion which puts enemies it Hits under the Watcher's Gaze. Killing those enemies, or Hitting them if Rare or Unique, causes this skill to summon temporary Foul Eye Minions.
즉시 플레이어를 얼음으로 둘러싸 일정 시간 동안 또는 일정 횟수 피격으로: Immediately encases you in ice, protecting you for a duration or until you take damage from a number of hits, and also grants a buff once the cast time has finished. You cannot move or perform non-instant actions while in the ice. When the ice breaks, the buff is also removed.
증오의 목자 크타쉬의 상을 소환합니다. 이 존재는 전투와 상관이 없습니다: Summon an illusion of K'tash, the Hate Shepherd. This is a non-combat entity.
지나간 자리에 얼음 파편을 남기는 관통 기병창을 1개 던집니다. 파편은: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.
지느러미가 달린 반려수에게 다른 플레이어의 애완동물을 잡아먹으라는 명령을: Direct your finned companion to feast upon another player's pet.
지대 효과를 생성하는 보조 대상 스킬에 적용되어, 효과의 지속시간을 늘려: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.
지대 효과를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 생성되는 지대가 훨씬 오래 지속되: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.
Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.
지대 효과를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 지대 효과가 일정 한도까지 점점: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.
지대 효과를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 해당 지대 효과로 인해 냉각된: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies Chilled by those Surfaces to be more easily Frozen, but at the cost of some Chill magnitude.
지면에 균열을 만드는 스킬에 적용되어, 부가 균열을 추가로 생성하게 합니: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.
지면에 균열을 만드는 스킬에 적용되어, 추가 균열을 1개 생성하게 합니다: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.
지면에 균열을 만드는 스킬에 적용되어, 추가 균열을 여러 개 생성하게 합: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.
지면에 부적을 배치해 자신과 범위 내 동료들에게 강력한 버프를 부여합니다: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Buff to you and Allies standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
지면에 부적을 배치해 자신과 범위 내 동료들에게 강력한 주문 피해 버프를: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.
지면에 위해를 끼치는 가시나무를 생성합니다. 가시나무는 잠시 후 활성화되: Creates Hazardous Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are Maimed. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time.
지면에 유독성 화살을 발사하여 비행 종료 시 가연성 독성 가스 구름을 생: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.
지면에서 녹아내린 바위를 끌어내 대상에게 던집니다. 충돌 시 투사체가 폭: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.
지면을 강타하면 요동치는 균열이 전방에 여러 개의 범위를 생성하며 순차적: Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.
지면을 강타하면 전방에 불타는 균열을 만들어 범위 피해를 주고, 그 균열: Slam the ground, unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Consume an Endurance Charge every third time you slam the ground with this skill.
지면을 강타하여 갈라지는 용암 균열을 생성합니다. 균열은 이동하면서 피해: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.
지면을 강타하여 굽이치는 균열을 생성합니다. 균열은 플레이어로부터 멀어지: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions.
지면을 강타하여 다수의 가시를 불러내 적들에게 피해를 줍니다. 핏빛 태세: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. You are in Blood Stance by default.
지면을 강타하여 적에게 범위 피해를 주는 균열 1개를 생성하고, 균열이: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.
Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage.
지면을 강타해 범위 내에 피해를 주고, 적을 감속시키는 요철 지대를 남깁: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.
지면을 강타해서 적들을 기절시키고 뒤로 밀어낸 후 계속 앞으로 전진하며: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.
지면을 대상으로 하지 않는 투사체를 발사하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.
지면을 찔러 전방 넓은 범위에 다수의 창들이 튀어나가게 합니다. 이 창들: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and Maiming them.
지면을 향해 고속으로 발사되는 얼음 볼트를 탑재한 탄창을 석궁에 장전합니: Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
지면을 훼손하고 시체를 소환하여 범위 내의 대상에게 카오스 피해를 줍니다: Desecrates the ground, summoning corpses and dealing chaos damage to all enemies in the area. The corpses will be chosen from the monsters in the current area and any Spectres that have existed in this instance.
Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.
Fire a Projectile at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a Chaos damage over time Debuff. Fires multiple Projectiles at enemies afflicted by multiple Debuffs, but Projectile count cannot be otherwise modified.
Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.
Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.
지속시간이 있는 모든 스킬에 적용되어, 지속시간을 크게 늘리고 재사용 대: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration significantly longer while applying a cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
지원되는 스킬로 중독된 적이 사망하면 발동하여 대상 주위의 적들에게 누적: Triggered when an enemy Poisoned by a supported skill dies, dealing Physical damage around them based on the built-up Plague.
직선 경로 내 적들을 관통하며 일정 확률로 얼리는 얼음 투사체를 발사합니: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.
직접 사용 또는 발동하는 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 공격이 사용 시: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.
직접 사용하거나 발동시키는 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 공격이 사용 시: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical and Cold damage based on their Runic Ward cost, in addition to causing Physical damage to Contribute to Freeze buildup. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.
직접 사용하거나 직접 발동시켜 피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.
직접 사용하거나 직접 발동시키는 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 명: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.
직접 사용하거나 직접 발동시키는 근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.
직접 사용하거나 직접 발동시키는 근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.
직접 사용하고 명중으로 적에게 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.
직접 사용하고 투사체를 발사하는 공격 스킬에 적용되어, 해당 스킬이 지속: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.
직접 사용하는 강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬에 독립적인 여진: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.
직접 사용하는 강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 룬 수호를 대량: Supports Slams you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of Runic Ward to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted Slams are Empowered with extra Physical damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an Aftershock after a duration. Cannot support Channelling Skills.
직접 사용하는 강타 스킬에 적용됩니다. 점화되었으며 방어구가 완전히 파괴: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.
직접 사용하는 강타에 적용되어, 가끔 매우 강력한 선대의 힘 증폭을 부여: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.
직접 사용하는 강타에 적용되어, 몇 초마다 강력한 선대의 힘 증폭을 부여: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
직접 사용하는 강타에 적용됩니다. 강타 뒤에 동시에 일어나는 여진이 생성: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.
직접 사용하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 공격이 강화되면, 비용: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.
직접 사용하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 사용하는 동안: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Armour, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
직접 사용하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 일정 한도까지: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
직접 사용하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 치명타 명중 시: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.
직접 사용하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 포위당한 상태일 때 보: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.
Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.
직접 사용하는 공격과 함성에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 적을 동결시키: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.
직접 사용하는 공격과 함성에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬에 영광 조건이:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
직접 사용하는 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 공격이 룬 수호를 희생하여: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.
직접 사용하는 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 사용할 때마다 공격: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.
직접 사용하는 근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 가하는 공: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Attacking with Supported Skills will cycle through various effects, with the first Attack in sequence inflicting Hobble on you. The second and third Attacks in sequence will powerfully scale chance to Critically Hit and overall damage, respectively, at which point the cycle will reset. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
직접 사용하는 근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 사용하는: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
직접 사용하는 근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 포위당한 상태일 때 마나가: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used while Surrounded.
직접 사용하는 근접 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 강력 기절하기 직: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
직접 사용하는 근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 인내 충: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills Consume all Endurance Charge on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each Charge Consumed. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.
직접 사용하는 근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬은 연계가 충분히: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.
Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.
직접 사용하는 근접 타격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 점화된 적: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.
직접 사용하는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 효과 범위가 대: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 가능하면 격분: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 가능하면 권능: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 시신을 소모하: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬 사용 시 시신을 여러: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 강화되어 있는 동안: Supports Skills which you use yourself. On using Supported Skills while they are Empowered, you gain Volatility.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 플레이어에게 걸린 일: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 어느 스킬로든 격노를 쓰면 버프를 획득: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.
직접 사용하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 적의 에너지 보호막을 파괴하면 카오스: Supports skills you use yourself, causing them to Trigger a Chaos Damage nova when breaking Enemy Energy Shield.
직접 사용하는 연속 가능 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문이 메아리칩니: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.
직접 사용하는 저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 저주가 만료될 때 저주받은 적에게: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.
직접 사용하는 주문 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 사용하는 동안: Supports Spell Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
직접 사용하는 집중 유지 스킬에 적용되어, 집중 유지 시간이 길수록 더: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.
직접 사용하는 집중 유지 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬에 집중 유지: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.
직접 사용하는 집중 유지 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬에 집중 유지하는 동안: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.
Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.
직접 사용하는 타격에 적용되어, 1초마다 강력한 선대의 힘 증폭을 부여하: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every second, at the cost of a damage penalty. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
직접 사용하는 타격에 적용되어, 몇 초마다 강력한 선대의 힘 증폭을 부여: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
직접 사용하는 타격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 명중을 일정 횟수 이: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.
직접 사용하는 투사체 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 이동하는 동안: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.
직접 사용하는 피해를 주는 스킬과 함성에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.
직접 사용하는 활 또는 창 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 처음에는: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.
직접 사용하며 사용 조건이 따로 없는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.
Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.
직접 사용하며 재사용 대기시간이 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 재사용 대기시간: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.
직접 사용하여 적을 명중하는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 시간이 지남에 따라: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.
Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.
직접 사용하여 적을 명중하는 비-집중 유지 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.
직접 사용하여 적을 명중하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 감전된: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.
Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.
직접 사용하여 적을 명중하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 치명타: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.
직접 사용하여 적을 명중하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 얼음 결정을: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills consume a Frenzy Charge on use to powerfully Break Armour.
Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.
Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Break Armour against Parried Enemies.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 일정 시간: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 사: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 치: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 피: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 명: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 감전된: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.
직접 사용하여 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 사용 중인 소환수 하나의: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.
직접 사용해서 피해를 주는 명중을 유발할 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.
직접 시전하는 반복 가능 주문에 적용되어, 해당 주문이 지속적으로 봉인되: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.
직접 시전하는 반복 가능 주문에 적용되어, 해당 주문이 지속적으로 봉인됩: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
직접 시전하는 비-즉시 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문이 자기 파편화: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.
직접 시전하는 연속 가능 주문에 적용되어, 막아낼 시 해당 주문이 봉인됩: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
직접 시전하는 연속 가능 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문이 3번 메아: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.
직접 시전하는 저주 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 사용 시 권능: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.
직접 시전하는 저주 주문에 적용됩니다. 저주가 평소의 저주 제한을 무시하: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.
직접 시전하는 주문에 적용되어, 보조 대상 주문에 소모한 마나를 계산합니: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.
직접 시전하는 주문에 적용되어, 해당 주문이 지속적으로 봉인됩니다. 시전: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
직접 시전하여 적을 명중하는 주문 스킬에 적용되어, 피해를 높여 주고 대: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.
집중 유지 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 집중 유지하는 동안 최대: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.
집중 유지로 커다란 폭발을 형성합니다. 집중 유지를 지속할수록 피해 범위: Channels to build up a large explosion. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion. The explosion occurs after using another skill or after a short period without casting.
집중 유지하여 목표 지점 근처에 자신의 덧없는 상들을 생성합니다. 상들은: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.
집중 유지하여 무기를 화염으로 충전합니다. 완벽한 타이밍에 방출하면 피해: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.
집중 유지하여 방어구에 룬 판금을 불어넣습니다. 판금이 있는 동안 명중당: Channel to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are Hit while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your Thorns damage in an area around your attacker.
집중 유지하여 불안정한 볼트를 충전합니다. 볼트는 지형에 부딪치면 파괴적: Channel to charge an unstable bolt. The bolt deals devastating damage and explodes on hitting terrain, but cannot be fired at all unless fully charged. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.
집중 유지하여 사방에 플레이어를 보호하는 거품을 생성합니다. 이 거품은: Channel to create a protective bubble all around you, Blocking Hits against you. While Channelling this Skill, you cannot be Light Stunned by Hits you Block, and damage you take from Hits is also removed from Runic Ward. Blocking Hits this way causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot recover Runic Ward while this Skill is active.
집중 유지하여 에너지 보호막을 재충전하고, 그 재충전이 넘칠 수 있게 합: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.
집중 유지하여 활을 충전한 후 강력하게 발사합니다. 완벽한 타이밍에 활을: Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with Perfect Timing causes the arrow to explode on impact and Consume Freeze on directly Hitting. Consuming Freeze enhances the explosion.
집중을 유지하며 이 스킬을 시전하면 점점 더 많은 생명력을 점유하며, 아: Channel this skill to reserve more and more of your life, building up power in a marker on the ground under you. Release to deal physical damage in an area based on how much life you reserved. Cannot be cast by Totems.
집중을 유지하며 켈라리에게 함께 집중 유지하라고 명령하여, 목표 지점 위: Channel and Command Kelari to Channel alongside you, creating blades that hang over the target location. The longer you Channel, the more blades Kelari will create. Upon release, his blades plunge into the ground and create shockwaves that deal Spell damage.
집중을 유지하여 강력한 휘두르기 공격을 충전하고, 지면에서 흙을 끌어올려: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own Attack time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.
집중을 유지하여 공중에 뼈 가시 무리를 생성한 후 적들을 향해 발사하고: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.
집중을 유지하여 주 근접 무도 무기를 담금질합니다. 모루를 망치로 타격할: Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.
집중을 유지하여 충전한 후 불타는 화살을 발사합니다. 최대 단계일 때 화: Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.
집중을 유지하여 플레이어의 주위에 파괴적인 에너지를 축적합니다. 에너지를: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channel for.
집중을 유지해서 대상 방향으로 돌진합니다. 이동 경로상의 적과 충돌하면: Channel to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.
Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.
징표 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 징표를 찍는 적에게 공격이 명: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.
Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.
징표 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 활성화되면 충전된 징표가 발동: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.
