징표 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 징표의 영향을 받은 적이 물리 피해를: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.
짧은 시간 동안 떨어진 지점을 파고드는 화살을 발사합니다. 지연시간이 종: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Shock. Shocking any enemy with the Bolt also applies Shock to all enemies near the impact.

Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.
짧은 시간 동안 지속되는 의식 문자의 고리를 생성합니다. 지속시간이 종료: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.
짧은 시간 동안 플레이어를 시간 마법으로 증강하여, 다음 시전하는 반복: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.
Summon a Pale Servitor. This is a non-combat entity.
Summon a Pale Cherubim. This is a non-combat entity.
Summon a Pale Angel. This is a non-combat entity.
창으로 바닥을 찍어, 접근 범위 내에 있는 모든 적에게 꽂힌 혈석 창을: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your Presence to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and Leech Life from enemies caught in the blast.
창을 바닥에 꽂아 주변 다수의 적과 동료, 시신에게 걸린 동결, 감전,: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.
창을 투척하여 지나간 자리에 화염 흔적을 남기고 적들을 불태웁니다. 이후: Throw a spear leaving a trail of Fire in its wake, Burning enemies. Then throws a second spear in the same direction, causing the trail of Fire to expand outwards.
창을 휘둘러 돌개바람을 일으킵니다. 돌개바람은 천방지축으로 전진하며 안에: Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.
창의 복제물 1개를 투척합니다. 적에게 적중하면 폭발하며 주위 넓은 범위: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.
처치한 몬스터의 영혼을 포획하고 이 젬으로 변환하여 몬스터의 유령을 부활: Capture the spirit of a defeated monster, transforming this gem to instead allow you to summon the monster's ghost as a Reviving Minion.
천천히 움직이는 관통 투사체를 발사합니다. 투사체는 적을 냉각시키는 데: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.
천천히 적 사이를 움직이는 투사체를 1개 발사합니다. 투사체 그 자체는: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.
철퇴나 셉터, 도끼, 지팡이로 지면을 강타하면 부서진 지면이 파도를 일으: Slams the ground with a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff, creating a wave of broken ground that damages enemies in an area in front of you. Enemies hit by the wave will release a circular shockwave, dealing damage to other enemies around them.
철퇴로 전방의 바닥을 후려치면 앞쪽으로 파도를 일으키며 뻗어 나가 적들에: The character slams the ground in front of them with a Mace, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun.
춤추는 수도승 1명이 나타나 플레이어 편에서 싸웁니다. 나타나는 동안 플: Manifests a Dancing Dervish to fight by your side. While manifested, you have Onslaught and cannot use the original item. Cannot be supported by supports that would create other minions.
춤추는 수도승 2명이 나타나 플레이어 편에서 싸웁니다. 춤추는 수도승이: Manifests two Dancing Dervishes to fight by your side. While a Dancing Dervish is manifested, you have Onslaught and cannot use the original item. Cannot be supported by supports that would create other minions.
충돌 시 폭발하는 커다란 화염의 구체를 날립니다. 이 폭발은 가능하면 화: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.
충돌 시 폭발하는 화염 볼트를 석궁에 장전합니다. 폭발은 해당 범위 내의: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
충돌 시 폭발하는 화염의 화살을 발사합니다. 폭발은 해당 범위 내의 유탄: Fire a flaming bolt that explodes on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
충전을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 권능 충전을 생성할: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.
충전을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 충전을 생성할 때 일정 확률로: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.
Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.
충전을 소모하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 해당 소모로 얻는 이익이 일정 확률로: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.
카오스 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨을 1 추가합니다. 레벨이 없는 스킬에는 적: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
켈라리에게 명령하여 목표 지점에 주문 피해를 주는 돌풍을 일으키고, 짧은: Command Kelari to create a blast at the target location that deals Spell damage, and leave behind a clone that persists for a short duration. This skill can store multiple charges, and using it again while a clone from a previous use is still alive causes that clone to explode, dealing even more damage.
켈라리에게 명령하여 목표 지점에 칼을 마구 던집니다. 칼은 바닥을 파고들: Command Kelari to throw a volley of knives at the target location. The knives burrow into the ground, then erupt into the air after a short delay, dealing Spell damage.
켈라리의 힘을 이용해 별도의 조작 없이 접근 범위 내에 있는 시신을 소모: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.
큰까마귀 떼의 일부에게 명령하여, 떼에서 떨어져 나가 일련의 환상 거울을: Command part of your flock to leave and crash through a set of illusory mirrors, Attacking enemies in the area between the mirrors with frequent Hits.
타격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 처치하는 희귀 적의 속성을 1: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.
타격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 처치하는 희귀 적의 속성을 2: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.
타격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 명중 시 일정 확률로 추가 연: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.
타격하는 소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 그 소환수의 타격이 근접 방: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.
타격하는 소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 효과 범위를 증가시키고 그: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.
타격한 대상으로부터 용암 투사체를 발사합니다. 투사체는 가까운 곳에 떨어: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck target, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.
타격한 적으로부터 용암 투사체를 발사합니다. 투사체는 가까운 곳에 떨어지: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck enemy, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.
Deals Physical Damage in an area, based on Totem Life.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어 그 토템을 1개 넘게 보유하지 못하게 하: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 스킬의 토템 설치 속도를 크게 올려 줍: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.
Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.
Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용되어, 토템의 생명력을 증폭시킵니다. 보조 대: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 생성된 토템이 격노: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Rage which will Leech Rage to Allies within it.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 생성된 토템이 마나: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 생성된 토템이 피의: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 생성하는 토템이 추: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.
토템을 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 한 번에 하나의 토템만 활성화되어 있: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.
토템을 소환할 때마다 이 스킬이 발동되어, 시전자를 위해 싸우는 선대의: This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.
투사체 스킬과 연쇄될 수 있는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 감전: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.
투사체 스킬과 연쇄하는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 연쇄하: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.
투사체 스킬에 적용되어, 원형으로 추가 투사체를 발사하게 합니다. 대신: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.
투사체 스킬에 적용되어, 원형으로 투사체를 발사하게 합니다. 투사체를 위: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.
Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.
투사체 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 투사체가 적을 관통하지만 관: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.
Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.
투사체 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 투사체가 적을 무제한으로 관: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.
Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
투사체 스킬에 적용됩니다. 투사체의 이동 속도가 빨라지고, 일정 확률로: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.
투사체 스킬에 적용됩니다. 투사체의 이동 속도가 빨라지고, 투사체 속도에: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.
Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.
투사체 주문에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문이 일정 확률로 다수의 추가 투: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.
Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
투사체를 발사하고 재사용 대기시간이 없으며 플레이어가 직접 사용하는 번개: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.
투사체를 발사하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 처음 투사체가 동: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.
투사체를 발사하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 처음 생성하는 투: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.
투사체를 발사하는 주문 스킬에 적용되어, 시전 속도 증가 및 감소가 투사: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.
투사체를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 최근 2초 내에 근접 명중으로 타격: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
투사체를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 최근 8초 내에 근접 명중으로 타격: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
투사체를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 투사체가 지형에 충돌할 때 연쇄하지: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, causing those Projectiles to Chain when impacting terrain, at the cost of any additional Projectiles, as well as causing them to always Pierce.
투사체를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 투사체가 지형에 충돌할 때 일정 확: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.
투사체를 확산 사격합니다. 투사체는 적에게 명중한 지점 뒤쪽의 작은 범위: Fire a burst of projectiles. The projectiles have a small area of damage behind where they impact enemies.
튕기는 유탄을 발사하고 퓨즈 지속시간이 만료되면 중독 가스를 방출하여 적: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.
튕기는 유탄을 발사하고, 퓨즈 지속시간이 만료되거나 적에게 충돌하면 기름: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
튕기는 유탄을 발사하여 퓨즈 지속시간이 만료되면 실명과 기절을 유발하는: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.
튕기는 유탄을 발사하여 퓨즈 지속시간이 만료되면 전기 처형 번개를 방출하: Fire a bouncing Grenade that discharges an Electrocuting Lightning blast when its fuse expires, causing all Lightning Hits against enemies to contribute to Electrocution buildup for a duration.
튕기는 유탄을 발사하여 퓨즈 지속시간이 만료되면 파괴적인 화염 폭발을 일: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.
튕기는 유탄을 발사합니다. 유탄은 퓨즈 지속시간이 만료되면 소형 유탄을: Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.
트리스켈리온의 불길의 힘을 빌려, 다음으로 시전하는 연속 가능 주문을 강: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.
팽창하는 에너지의 파도가 전방으로 뿜어 나가며, 지속시간 동안 부채꼴 형: An expanding wave of energy surges forward, damaging enemies in a cone-shaped area over a duration. Each enemy hit is inflicted with Exposure matching the element of which they took the highest damage. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time.
폭발 스킬을 보조하여, 해당하는 스킬이 사용 시 플레이어의 주위가 아니라: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.
폭발 시 범위 피해를 주는 지뢰를 투척하면, 불타는 투사체들이 발사되어: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area.
Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.
폭발 시 시전자를 폭발 지점으로 순간이동시키는 지뢰를 투척합니다. 탈출: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
폭발 시 주변으로 투사체를 발사하는 지뢰를 투척합니다. 지뢰에서 발사된: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing
폭발하는 시신의 주위 지역에 시신의 최대 생명력에 따라 화염 피해를 줍니: Deals Fire damage in an area around the exploding Corpse based on its maximum Life.
폭발하여 대상과 주변의 다른 적들에게 화염 피해를 주고, 높은 확률로 불: Fires an arrow that explodes, dealing fire damage to its target and other nearby enemies, with an increased chance of igniting them.
Explode, dealing Fire damage in an area.
폭풍 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬의 제한이 증가하고, 폭풍이 사용: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.
폭풍 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 사용자의 위치에 나타나 목표: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.
플레이어 뒤에 자리를 잡는 포병대 소환수를 영입합니다. 포병대는 기다리다: Recruit artillery Minions that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your Command, then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.
플레이어 앞에 화염의 벽을 생성하여 범위 내에 있는 모든 것을 점화합니다: Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.
플레이어가 사용하거나 직접 발동시켜 피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.
플레이어가 사용하거나 직접 발동시키는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.
플레이어가 있는 곳에 영원의 구슬을 만들어, 그 안에 있는 적들의 행동: Creates an Eternity Sphere at your location, which reduces the Action Speed of enemies within it. The amount of Action Speed reduction applied by the sphere decreases to zero over its duration.
플레이어가 있는 지점과 대상 지점에 징표들을 만듭니다. 징표는 시간이 지: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
플레이어가 주변의 적에게 순간이동합니다. 플레이어에게 짧은 시간 동안 버: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack.
Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.
플레이어가 직접 사용하고 피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.
플레이어가 직접 사용하는 공격 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬을 사용: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
플레이어가 직접 사용하는 근접 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 플레: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.
플레이어가 처치하는 적과 명중하는 희귀 또는 고유 적의 내밀한 공포를 끌: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.
플레이어에게 접근해 있는 동료들과 플레이어에게 총 에너지 보호막을 추가로: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.
플레이어에게 접근해 있는 동료들과 플레이어의 냉기 저항을 증가시키는 오라: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
플레이어에게 접근해 있는 동료들과 플레이어의 번개 저항을 증가시키는 오라: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
플레이어에게 접근해 있는 동료들과 플레이어의 카오스 저항을 증가시키는 오: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
플레이어에게 접근해 있는 동료들과 플레이어의 화염 저항을 증가시키는 오라: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.
Casts an aura that grants life regeneration to you and your allies.
Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.
플레이어의 접근 범위 내에 굴절의 거울이 주기적으로 나타납니다. 주문 투: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.
This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.
플레이어의 최대 에너지 보호막을 크게 감소시키는 버프를 부여하고 장착한: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped weapons into Swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. This skill cannot be triggered.
피가 격렬하게 폭발합니다. 이 폭발은 플레이어의 무기 피해에 기반하지 않: A violent explosion of blood that deals Physical Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon's damage.
피투성이 낫을 생성하고 목표 지역을 휩쓸어 적들에게 물리 피해를 주고 치: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness. Cannot be Triggered.
Bloody scythes swipe around a selected area, hitting enemies with physical damage. An area of boiling blood is left beneath them for a duration which deals physical damage over time. Also gives a bonus to maximum Blood Charges for a secondary duration.
피해를 받을 수 있는 반려수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.
피해를 받을 수 있는 소환수를 생성하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 소환수와 소환: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.
피해를 받을 수 있는 소환수의 생명력을 일부 희생하여 소환수 주변의 일정: Sacrifice some of a damageable Minion's life to deal Physical damage in an area around it.
피해를 받지 않는 신비로운 연무의 큰까마귀를 소환합니다. 큰까마귀에게 명: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be Commanded to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a Frenzy Charge for each enemy it Culls.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 격노 수치가 높을수록 보: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 번개: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 출혈을: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬은 실명: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 이 명중으로 유발하는 출: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발하는 주문 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 주문 사: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발할 수 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 추가 카오스 피해를: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.
Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.
Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.
Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.
피해를 주는 명중을 유발할 수 있는 스킬에 적용되어, 해당 명중이 적의: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 물리 피해가 커지고, 대신 그 외: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 물리 피해가 커지는 대신 그 외 모: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 공격이 카오스 피해를 획득하: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 냉기 피해를 획득하지만 화염: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 번개 피해를 획득하지만 냉기: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 주는 비-상태 이상 지속 피: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 스킬이 화염 피해를 획득하지만 냉기: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 지속시간이 1초 미만인 효과가 주는: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.
피해를 주는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 플레이어가 보조 대상 스킬로 처치하: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.
피해를 주는 스킬에 적용되어, 스킬 명중의 최대 물리 피해를 증가시킵니다: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.
피해를 주는 스킬에 적용되어, 최근 몇 초 동안 사용한 서로 다른 명령: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
피해를 주는 스킬에 적용됩니다. 최근 4초 이내 사용한 원소 유형이 다른: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.
피해를 주는 스킬을 사용하면 루잔이 나타나 대상 근처에 있는 적들을 열광: When you use a damaging Skill, Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies near your target with zealous fervour, inflicting Exposure.
피해를 주는 주문을 시전할 때 권능 충전을 소모하여 심연의 유령을 발동시: Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.
피해를 주는 함성을 질러 주변의 적들을 뒤로 밀어내고 기절 준비 완료 상: Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
피해를 줄 수 있는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 주는 번개: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.
하나의 적에게 지속 카오스 피해를 주는 디버프를 겁니다. 전염의 영향을: Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
하늘에서 얼음 덩어리를 불러내려 대상 지점에 큰 피해를 줍니다. 가까이에: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.
하늘에서 천상의 무기가 연속으로 떨어져 적들에게 피해를 주고, 떨어질 때: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider but less damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
하늘을 조준하고 충전된 볼트를 발사하고 대상 위치 주위에 떨어트려 피해를: Aims skyward and fires charged bolts that land around the target location, dealing damage and lodging in the ground for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause these bolts to explode. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.
하늘을 조준하여, 다른 번개 공격으로 생성되어 전방에 남아 있는 볼트 또: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
하늘을 향해 사격한 후 떨어진 지점에서 회오리를 일으켜 지속 물리 피해를: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.
한 지역을 대상으로 지정하여 시전 속도에 비례한 단계를 해당 지역에 형성: Targets an area and builds up stages in that area based on cast speed. It explodes every 3 stages, until it reaches a maximum of 15. As it gains more stages, the area gets smaller but the damage gets higher.
한 지역을 목표로 하여 커다란 폭발을 형성합니다. 축적 속도는 시전 속도: Targets an area and builds up a large explosion. The build-up speed is based on cast speed. The explosion occurs after it reaches 10 stacks.
한 지점으로 순간이동하며 적들에게 피해를 주고, 이동 경로를 따라 용암: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground in your wake. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
함성 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 강화되는 공격을 사용할 때 일: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.
함성 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 완전히 파괴된 방어구를 소모하: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.
함성 스킬에 적용됩니다. 함성 사용 시 집계된 몬스터 위세에 따라 격노를: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.
함성에 적용되어, 함성이 얼음 결정 및 얼음 파편을 파괴하게 합니다. 보: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.
함성에 적용됩니다. 뒤틀린 맹약이 발동되어 플레이어의 생명력을 소모하고: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.
함성에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 2회 메아리칩니다. 범위가 점점 커: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.
Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.
함성에 적용됩니다. 타락한 함성이 발동되어 효과 범위 내 적들에게 타락한: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.
함성에 적용됩니다. 함성이 격노를 소비하여 평소의 재사용 대기시간을 무시: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.
Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.
함성을 질러 이어지는 공격을 강화합니다. 치명타 확률을 올려 주고 공격이: Performs a warcry, empowering subsequent attacks. Grants a buff which boosts critical strike chance and allows attacks to benefit from increases to spell damage.
함성을 질러, 주변에 적이 있다면 이어지는 근접 공격을 강화합니다. 함성: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
함성을 질러, 주변에 적이 있을 경우 시전자 및 주변 동료들의 피해와 마: Performs a warcry, granting increased damage and mana regeneration to the user and nearby allies if there are nearby enemies. The damage increase is proportional to the number of surrounding enemies. Shares a cooldown with other Warcry skills.
해골 돌격병에게 명령을 내려 함성을 내지르게 합니다. 이 함성은 주변 적: Command a Skeletal Brute to use a Warcry, Intimidating nearby enemies and Consuming Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
해골 서리 마법사에게 명령을 내려 한 위치 또는 소환수를 대상으로 지정하: Command a Skeletal Frost Mage to target a location or Minion and apply Ice Armour to Minions in an area, reducing damage taken from Hits, causing damage to enemies that Hit them, and counting as Frozen for other effects.
해골을 뼈 가시로 뀁니다. 가시가 남아 있는 동안 강력한 주문 피해 버프:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
해골을 뼈다귀로 만들어진 가시로 꿰고 가시가 남아 있는 동안 주변의 소환:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
허공으로 다수의 화살을 쏘면, 잠시 후 대상 주변에 떨어집니다. 사용 시: Fires a large number of arrows into the air, to land in an area around the target after a short delay. Consumes a Frenzy Charge on use to fire additional arrows.
허공으로 화살을 쏘면, 목표 지역 주위에 떨어져 내리며 명중한 적에게 피: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and slows their movement speed. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.
혈액상실 상태의 적을 죽이면 피의 폭발이 일어나, 주변 적들에게 물리 공: Killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon Damage, but is based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic.
형태 변환 스킬에 적용되어, 해당 스킬로 인하여 형태 변환할 때 잠시 헬: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.
형태 변환하는 혼백 그릇 반려수를 소환합니다. 이 반려수는 플레이어가 장: Summons a Shapeshifting Spirit Vessel Companion that uses copies of socketed Bear, Werewolf, and Wyvern Skills.
호를 그리며 주위를 휩쓰는 얼음 투사체를 발사합니다. 다수의 투사체가 동: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.
화살 또는 창을 연속으로 발사할 준비를 하며 반복 가능한 다음 활 또는: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.
화살을 공중에 발사합니다. 화살은 짧은 지연시간 후에 떨어지며 적에게 피: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.
화살을 공중으로 퍼부어 위쪽에서 비처럼 쏟아지게 합니다. 격분 충전을 소: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes a Frenzy Charge to fire more arrows.
화살을 발사하여 대상에게 주는 물리 피해의 일부를 냉기 피해로 전환하고,: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. When you use this skill, it summons a squad of Mirage Sharpshooters for a duration. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
화살을 발사해 대상 지점에 도달하거나 충돌시 범위 피해를 주고 부식성 지: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
화염 스킬에 적용되어, 레벨을 1 추가합니다. 레벨이 없는 스킬에는 적용: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
화염 주문 스킬에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 적을 점화할 때 원소 집: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.
활 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 세 번 사격할 때마다 마나 소모: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.
활 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬로 세 번 사격할 때마다 피해를 추: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.
활 공격에 적용됩니다. 보조 대상 스킬이 네 방향 중 한 방향을 표시하고: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
활 또는 창을 장착하고 있는 동안 탈 수 있는 반려수 로아에게 고삐를 씌: Harnesses a Companion Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a Bow or Spear. While mounted you can use Bow, thrown Spear, and Mark Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being Hit will cause Heavy Stun buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.
Fire an arrow with your Bow.
활성화 시 늑대 반려수 무리를 소환합니다. 늑대 무리는 늑대의 수와 무관: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.
활성화 시 부활 능력이 있고 공격적인 해골 강탈자를 소환합니다. 명령을: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage
활성화 시 부활 능력이 있는 원거리 해골 저격수를 소환합니다. 명령을 내: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.
활성화 시 부활 능력이 있는 폭탄 투척 해골 방화범을 소환합니다. 명령을: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.
활성화 시 부활 능력이 있는 해골 서리 마법사를 소환합니다. 해골 서리: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.
활성화 시 부활 능력이 있는 해골 성직자를 소환합니다. 해골 성직자는 다: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.
Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.
활성화 시 부활 능력이 있는 해골 폭풍 마법사를 소환합니다. 명령을 내리: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.
Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.
활성화 시 부활하는 해골 돌격병을 소환합니다. 해골 돌격병은 강한 공격으: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.
활성화 시 장착한 주문을 순서대로 시전하고 부활 능력이 있는 악마 신관을: Activate to summon a Reviving Demon Magus which casts socketed Spells in order.
활성화 시 하이에나 반려수 무리를 소환합니다. 하이에나 무리는 하이에나의: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.
활성화된 동안 감전된 적을 비-전령 공격 명중으로 처치하면 이어지는 공격: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which dealAttack damage to all surrounding enemies.
활성화된 동안 격노가 강화되지만, 격노를 잃지 않는 동안에는 생명력을 잃: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.
활성화된 동안 공격이 명중하면 룬 수호가 소모되며 베리시움 현신이 소환됩: While active, Hitting with an Attack will spend Runic Ward to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived Temporary Minion that rapidly Attacks nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
활성화된 동안 구르기를 사용하면 단명하는 플레이어의 환상 복제물을 생성합: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.

While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.
활성화된 동안 근접 공격으로 적을 명중시키면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Lightning spells on reaching maximum Energy.
While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 근처에 강렬한 룬 에너지가 깃든 지점이 드러납니다. 이러한: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.
활성화된 동안 기절하면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면 장착된: While active, gains Energy when you are Stunned and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 다른 스킬의 치명타 명중으로 대상을 처치하거나 강력한 대상: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.
활성화된 동안 달리면 메뚜기 떼로 변신해, 주변 지역에 무기의 피해에 기: While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals Physical Attack damage, which is not based on your Weapon's damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain Heavy Stun buildup if this Hits any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply Heavy Stun or interrupt your sprinting.
활성화된 동안 동료 히드라가 몸에서 솟아나와 주변의 감전, 동결, 점화: While active, a companion Hydra will rear up from your body and regularly cast socketed Projectile Spells at nearby Shocked, Frozen, and Ignited enemies.
활성화된 동안 따로 조작하지 않아도 가까운 과거의 잔상을 남깁니다. 주문: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.
활성화된 동안 따로 조작하지 않아도 막기 확률이 증가하고 방패에 지속적으: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to Trigger the Magma Spray skill and grant you an Endurance Charge.
활성화된 동안 막아내면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면 장착된: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.
While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 번개 피해를 받으면 충전이 축적됩니다. 충전이 가득 차면: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.
활성화된 동안 번쩍이는 방어막을 소환합니다. 이 방어막은 능력치 유형별로: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each Attribute type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are Hit.
활성화된 동안 비-전령 공격 명중으로 적을 산산이 조각내면 얼음 폭발을: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.
활성화된 동안 스킬을 집중 유지하면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달: While active, gains Energy while you're channelling a skill and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 아무 스킬로나 접근해 있는 감전된 적을 처음 명중할 때,: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.
활성화된 동안 에너지 보호막이 적의 명중으로 피해를 받으면 에너지를 얻습: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
활성화된 동안 원거리 투사체 공격을 발사하면, 신기루가 나타나서 짧은 시: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
활성화된 동안 잔류물을 획득하면 치명적인 폭발이 발동되어, 획득한 잔류물: While active, picking up Remnants Triggers a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the Remnant based on the type of Remnant picked up.
활성화된 동안 적들에게서 주운 방어구 파편을 사용해서 자신의 방어구를 보: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. Fully Breaking an enemy's Armour grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's Rarity, and you gain Armour and Thorns per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.
활성화된 동안 적으로부터 에너지 보호막에 명중 피해를 받으면, 짧은 시간: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.
활성화된 동안 적을 감전시키면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면: While active, gains Energy when you Shock enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 적을 공격하면 광분이 축적됩니다. 이 스킬을 사용하면 광분: While active, your Fury builds from Attacking enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and Onslaught but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.
활성화된 동안 적을 공격하면 영광이 축적됩니다. 영광이 최대일 때 일정: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed.

While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.

While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.
활성화된 동안 적을 근접 공격으로 기절시키면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 적을 근접 공격으로 처치하면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 적을 기절시키거나 처치하면 일정 확률로 룬 수호 잔류물이: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.
활성화된 동안 적을 동결시키거나 감전시키거나 점화시키면 에너지를 얻고,: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 적을 동결시키면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 적을 점화시키면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면: While active, gains Energy when you Ignite enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 적의 동결, 감전, 점화, 완전히 파괴된 방어구를 소모하여: While active, Consuming Freeze, Shock, Ignite, or Fully Broken Armour on an enemy reloads your Crossbow, restores one cooldown use for your Grenades and grants a Buff causing Crossbow Attacks to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.
활성화된 동안 적이 접근해 있으면 곤충 무리가 플레이어의 몸에서 나와 주: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable Minions that Attack and Poison enemies.
활성화된 동안 전투 시간이 길어질수록 희귀 및 고유 적에게 주는 명중 피: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.
활성화된 동안 접근해 있는 적들에게 기절 및 원소 상태 이상이 더 쉽게: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.
활성화된 동안 접근해 있는 적들에게 주기적으로 위축을 유발하는 오라를 방: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.
활성화된 동안 주기적으로 신의 축복을 발생시켜 자신을 치유하고, 저주와: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.
활성화된 동안 주기적으로 유령 연막을 획득합니다. 유령 연막이 있는 동안: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.
활성화된 동안 주는 중독 피해의 일부를 저장합니다. 이 스킬을 사용하면: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.
활성화된 동안 중독된 적을 처치하면 중독이 주변의 적들에게 퍼지고, 일정: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.
While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.
활성화된 동안 지속적으로 플라스크 충전을 부여하고, 플레이어의 플라스크로: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.
활성화된 동안 직접 사용하는 화염 주문이 격노의 유령도 소환합니다. 격노: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
활성화된 동안 치명타 명중 시 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 플레이어가 적을 동결시키거나 전기 처형하거나 고정하면 격분: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.
활성화된 동안 플레이어가 주는 물리 공격 피해의 일부가 저장됩니다. 주문: While active, a portion of the Physical Attack damage you deal is stored. Casting a Spell uses the stored damage to create a patch of Thorny Ground that deals Spell damage to moving enemies.
활성화된 동안 플레이어의 스킬이 부활하는 언데드 소환수를 시신 대신 사용: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.
활성화된 동안 플레이어의 유지형 소환수가 처치되면 에너지를 얻고, 최대: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.
활성화된 동안 피해를 받으면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도달하면 장: While active, gains Energy when you take damage and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 혈액상실 상태의 적을 죽이면 피의 폭발이 일어나, 주변 적: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
활성화된 동안 호신부 중 하나를 사용하면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 활성화된 충전에 따라 강력한 버프를 얻습니다. 하지만 버프: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.
활성화된 동안 회피 구르기를 사용하면 에너지를 얻고, 에너지가 최대에 도: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
활성화된 동안 회피 구르기를 하면, 신기루가 나타나서 짧은 시간 동안 장: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.
활성화된 동안 회피 시 지나간 자리에 마름쇠를 흩뿌림: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.
활성화된 동안, 구르기를 공간을 돌파하여 즉시 어느 정도 떨어진 곳에 나: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.
활성화된 동안, 단계의 수에 따라 회피를 증폭시키는 버프의 단계를 부여합: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.
활성화된 동안, 대상을 동결시키거나 감전시키거나 점화할 때 일정 확률로: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.
활성화된 동안, 대체 시간선에 존재하는 자신의 상이 간혹 나타나서 첫 번: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.
활성화된 동안, 방어도 또는 기타 피해 감소 수단으로 방지되는 물리 피해: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.
활성화된 동안, 부활 소환수가 죽을 때 최대 생명력의 일정 비율을 으스스: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.
활성화된 동안, 비-전령 공격으로 충분한 과잉살상 피해를 줘서 적을 처치: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.
활성화된 동안, 비-집중 유지 주문이 최대 마나에 따라 추가 마나를 소모: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.
활성화된 동안, 사용 즉시 에너지 보호막 재충전이 시작되고 일정 시간 동: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.
While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.
활성화된 동안, 원소 상태 이상의 영향을 받는 적들을 처치하거나 원소 상: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and inflict Faerie Fire on Hit.
활성화된 동안, 점차 단계가 증가하는 얼음 방벽을 생성합니다. 방벽 단계: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.
활성화된 동안, 접근해 있는 적들에게 지속적으로 치명타 약화를 유발하는: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.
활성화된 동안, 플레이어가 마나를 사용하면 에너지를 얻습니다. 에너지를: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.
활성화된 동안, 플레이어가 적을 근접 공격으로 처치하면 에너지를 얻습니다: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
활성화된 동안, 플레이어가 적을 동결, 감전, 점화시키면 에너지를 얻습니: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
활성화된 동안, 플레이어가 주문을 시전하면 에너지를 얻습니다. 에너지를: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.
Clear your active Bolt and reload any ammunition.
활성화된 활 또는 창을 준비하여 반복 가능한 다음 활 또는 투사체 창 공: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.
활에 마법에 걸린 화살을 장전하고 회전해서 앞으로 나아가며 원형으로 발사: Load your Bow with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes Frenzy Charges to cause the arrows to deal more damage and Chain to other targets. Each target can only be Hit once.
회전 공격을 하여 주변의 적들에게 피해를 주고 시전자의 태세에 상응하는: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. You are in Blood Stance by default.
회피 구르기가 폭발의 힘을 이용하는 도약으로 변경됩니다. 대포 의족으로: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.
효과 범위가 있는 모든 스킬에 적용됩니다. 효과 범위가 줄어들지만, 주는: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.
희귀 몬스터의 시신을 희생하여 일정 시간 동안 그 몬스터의 속성들을 부여: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration, or gain a single random Modifier at the cost of your own life force.
히네코라가 당신의 미래-과거를 들여다보고 나쁜 운명을 피할 기회를 줍니다: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.
